title: Railway Supervisor
description:
What is IP Corporation?

IP Corporation is a privately held, family-owned chemical manufacturing organization with more than 70 years of stability, innovation, and growth. Headquartered in Minnesota, IP Corporation supports a portfolio of operating companies that manufacture and distribute resins, gel coats, composite materials, and specialty polymer solutions used across a wide range of industrial applications.

Our operating companies, Interplastic Corporation, North American Composites, HK Research, and Molding Products, work together to deliver technical expertise, high-quality products, and long-term partnerships to customers around the world. We are known for our customer-first mindset, strong technical capabilities, and collaborative culture built on trust and continuous improvement.


What is a Railway Supervisor?

The Railway Supervisor is responsible for the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of all rail activities within the facility. This position manages railcar switching operations, coordinates inbound rail shipments from suppliers, oversees rail yard logistics, and ensures compliance with Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) regulations and company safety policies.

The Railway Supervisor serves as the site subject matter expert for rail operations and FRA requirements, supporting rail training initiatives and maintaining operational readiness. This position also provides backup support to the Materials Manager as needed. The ideal candidate brings strong rail operations experience, excellent leadership and communication skills, and a demonstrated commitment to safety, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.


What You Can Expect to Do as a Railway Supervisor:

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute railcar switching activities in the rail yard, and safely operate locomotives, Trackmobiles, and associated rail equipment.
  • Manage inbound and outbound railcar movements to support production and supply chain requirements, coordinating placement and removal with suppliers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Serve as the site lead for FRA compliance and rail safety programs, maintaining site operating procedures, training records, and regulatory readiness.
  • Coordinate and support FRA-required training for rail personnel, and communicate regulatory changes to affected employees.
  • Conduct job briefings, audits, and inspections, identify compliance gaps, and implement corrective actions.
  • Apply non-main track rules and switching procedures, including operating switches and derails, coupling and uncoupling railcars, connecting air hoses, and applying hand brakes.
  • Perform daily inspections of locomotives, Trackmobiles, railcars, brakes, and safety devices, and complete operating reports, switching records, and required documentation.
  • Provide backup support to the Materials Manager, assisting with inbound raw material scheduling, inventory management, and coordination with production, logistics, and procurement.
  • Promote a culture of safety and accountability, ensuring all rail activities meet FRA, OSHA, DOT, environmental, and company requirements.


What We Are Looking For in a Railway Supervisor:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Three to five years of experience operating locomotives, Trackmobiles, or similar rail equipment.
  • Demonstrated experience with rail switching operations and rail yard activities.
  • Working knowledge of FRA regulations and rail safety practices.
  • Strong organizational and planning abilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Valid driver’s license.


Why Join IP Corporation?

  • Be part of a stable, privately held organization with more than 70 years of success and a strong reputation in the markets we serve.
  • Lead meaningful work in a company where decisions can be made quickly, ideas are valued, and employees have a direct impact on business results.
  • Competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, and a 401(k) with company match.
  • Collaborate with talented teams across a diverse portfolio of businesses and manufacturing operations.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, leadership development, and long-term career advancement.
  • Join a culture built on integrity, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Help shape the future of an organization committed to innovation, customer success, and operational excellence.


IP Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable laws.

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.


Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. title: Sommerjobb i Veidekke Anlegg 2027
description:
Veidekke er Norges største entreprenørselskap med prosjekter, anlegg og driftskontrakter over store deler av landet. Nå søker Veidekke Anlegg kandidater til sommerjobb fra juni-august 2026. Vi ser etter deg som studerer til å bli sivilingeniør, byggingeniør, høyskoleingeniør eller går på teknisk fagskole.

En sommerjobb hos oss vil gjøre deg godt kjent med våre prosjekter og produksjon. Her får du stifte bekjentskap med mange av våre fag og folk, og du får et godt innblikk i vår modell for prosjektgjennomføring.

Arbeidsoppgaver du kan få

Variasjon er nøkkelordet for en sommerjobb hos oss. Alle prosjekter er ulike. Vi kan ikke love deg alt, men du vil kunne få bryne deg på ulike fag og oppgaver innen områder som for eksempel driftsoppfølging, HMS, stikning- og landmåling eller kvalitet. Vi ønsker at sommerjobbstudentene skal bli kjent med vår produksjon og kanskje også få være med våre fagarbeidere på en eller flere produksjonsoppgaver.


I Veidekke Anlegg jobber vi med prosjekter og kontrakter helt fra planleggingsstadiet til ferdigstillelse. Det gir deg et innblikk og erfaring med svært mange fag og en kompleksitet som du kun finner hos entreprenørselskapene. I Veidekke er vi spesialister på hele leveransen til en kunde og vi elsker fag, kompleksitet og samspill mellom mennesker på alle nivåer. Så det er fint om du du tenker at det høres spennende ut!

Dette ser vi etter hos deg

Vi ser etter deg som tar initiativ, liker utfordringer, mennesker og teamarbeid. Du er interessert i hva en utførende entreprenør gjør og har lyst til å bli bedre kjent med oss i Veidekke.


Du må like å prøve nye ting, for vi kommer til å gi deg varierte oppgaver - om noen er enkle, vil andre være mer utfordrende. Om du vet at løsninger blir enda bedre når du løser dem sammen med andre, da tror vi du vil trives i vår gjeng sommeren 2027.


Vi liker å ha det gøy på jobben i Veidekke. Vi mener det er sammenheng mellom trivsel og kvalitet i arbeidet vi utfører og en trygg og sikker arbeidsplass. Vi har selvsagt bransjens dyktigste og hyggeligste folk hos oss. Det er derfor viktig at du kan utfordre deg selv og er komfortabel med å bli en del av en slik gjeng i løpet av noen hektiske sommermåneder.

Vi gir deg

En sommerjobb hos oss vil gi deg praktisk erfaring som du kan ta med deg videre i studiene. Både du og vi skal få utbytte av jobben du gjør. Og det er ingen hemmelighet at vi bruker sommerjobbene til å vurdere egnede studenter til Veidekkes program for nyutdannede på et senere tidspunkt. En sommerjobb er derfor både en lærerik erfaring og en inngangsport til jobb hos oss senere. Lønn fastsettes etter satser for utdanningsløp og hvor langt du er kommet i studiene.

Praktisk info til deg som søker

En sommerjobb kan du ha fra juni og ut august. Oppstart og varighet kan variere og avtales nærmere på intervju. Her er det fint om du vet hvor lenge og når du kan starte opp i jobben.

Vår anleggsvirksomhet er i stor grad mobil. Det betyr at du vil bo på anleggsbrakke og ha en arbeidstidsordning lik det prosjektet du skal jobbe på. Du kan jobbe med jernbane, veianlegg, tunneler og mye mer. Husk å fortelle kort om din motivasjon for jobben i søknaden du laster opp. Under intervju vil du også få mer informasjon om konkrete prosjekter.


Søknadsfrist: 31. desember 2027. Vi har fortløpende opptak, så et godt tips er å være tidlig ute med å søke. Husk å legge ved CV-en din og dine foreløpige karakterer.



Veidekke er en av Skandinavias største entreprenører. Selskapet utfører alle typer bygg- og anleggsoppdrag, vedlikeholder veier og produserer asfalt, pukk og grus. Involvering og lokalkunnskap kjennetegner virksomheten. Omsetningen er om lag 43 milliarder kroner, og nær halvparten av de 7 800 medarbeiderne eier aksjer i selskapet. Veidekke er notert på Oslo Børs og har siden starten i 1936 alltid gått med overskudd.


Stillingen inngår i Veidekke Infrastruktur, som driver landsdekkende anleggsvirksomhet med prosjekter innenfor vei, bane, kraftanlegg, industrianlegg og flyplasser for private og offentlige kunder. Selskapet er Norges største asfaltentreprenør og nest største produsent av pukk og grus. I tillegg har selskapet betydelig aktivitet innen drift og vedlikehold av det offentlige veinettet i hele landet. Årlig omsetning er på NOK 10,4 milliarder (2025), og virksomheten har ca. 2 100 ansatte, hvorav 1 250 fagarbeidere og 850 funksjonærer.

title: Strategic Planning Basin Coordinator
company: St. Johns River Water Management District
description:
Strategic Planning Basin Coordinator

Bureau of Basin Management and Project Development


The St. Johns River Water Management District is an environmental agency whose work is focused on it’s four core missions; water supply, flood protection, water quality and natural systems in 18 counties in northeast and east-central Florida. The Bureau of Basin Management and Project Development is responsible for developing and managing project solutions which support the District’s core missions, increasing organizational efficiency and effectiveness, and implementation of specific workplans to address challenges in each of the Strategic Planning Basins. Bureau staff enjoy a work-life balance in a professional culture with competitive pay and benefits.

Job Summary:

Advanced professional work developing and managing basin specific initiatives, including planning and prioritization of projects, process design, and delivery of results through communication, facilitation, and influence.


Job duties include:

  • Develops basin priorities and clearly defined objectives for assigned strategic planning basin; advocates and influences appropriate change and needs across the assigned basin, including project selection and prioritization. This includes developing a basin plan for the assigned basin by building upon SJRWMD’s prior surface water improvement management plans.
  • Facilitates and coordinates the resources needed to effectively deliver the milestones/objectives for the assigned strategic planning basin. This includes coordinating with division work groups to develop work plans, schedules, and monitoring. Advocates and influences change and needs across the planning basin, including water quality, flood protection, and natural system project selection and prioritization.
  • Presents and advocates to the media, leadership, the Governing Board, regional stakeholders and other parties as required on assigned strategic planning basin. This includes internal and external coordination and communication.
  • Assists with the development, implementation and management of scopes, budgets, and District documents associated with the assigned basin.

Skilled In:

Building collaborative partnerships; project management; written and oral communication; presenting; problem solving and developing sound solutions to new or complex problems; influencing without authority.


Ability To:

Communicate clearly and fluently both orally and in writing; take responsibility and initiative on projects; act with confidence and a sense of urgency; support and act on decisions that have been made; adapt to changing circumstances; work in collaboration and establish good relationships with stakeholders and colleagues at all levels; build wide and effective networks of contacts; set clearly defined objectives and design detailed plans and strategies to achieve results; manage time effectively by identifying and organizing resources needed to accomplish tasks; monitor performance against deadlines and milestones and work to realize the goals; apply specialist and or technical expertise and probe for further information or greater understanding of work related problems; make rational judgments from available information and analyze and produce workable solutions to a range of problems; make presentations including to the Governing Board, and to external audiences.


Minimum Qualifications:

A bachelor's degree in a natural or environmental science, water resources, engineering or related field and five years of professional experience in the environmental or water resources field, one of which includes leading a project team, coordination activities of a work group, or serving as a team lead.

A master’s degree from an accredited college or university with a major in natural or environmental science, water resources, engineering or related field can substitute for one year of the required experience as described above.

A doctorate from an accredited college or university with a major in natural or environmental science, water resources, engineering or related field can substitute for two years of the required experience as described above.

Professional experience as described above can substitute on a year-for-year basis for the required education

Valid State of Florida Driver’s License.

title: Commercial Director (Volunteer)
description:
Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute, significantly, to the impact that we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department that they work in of the level of time that they are able to commit. Our services primarily offer a peer-support network to young people right across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor who is of a similar age to them and somebody that they feel more comfortable speaking with.

If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse, but likeminded individuals, collaborating to increase the reach of the Charity and improve support provisions available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are remote workers, but that doesn't stop us keeping in touch and maintaining a strong positive culture amongst our whole team.

About the role

We're looking for an ambitious, entrepreneurial Commercial Director to lead the growth of Y4Y Trading.

This is a unique opportunity to build a social enterprise from the ground up—developing commercial ventures that create genuine social impact while generating sustainable income for a growing charity.

You'll have the freedom to shape strategy, launch new initiatives, and turn innovative ideas into thriving businesses. Working closely with the Y4Y Trading Board and the Charity Executive Board, you'll play a pivotal role in creating long-term financial sustainability for Youth4Youth.

If you're someone who enjoys building businesses, spotting opportunities, driving growth, and creating lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

As Commercial Director, you'll lead the development and growth of Y4Y Trading's commercial activities by:

  • Developing and launching ethical commercial ventures aligned with Youth4Youth's mission.

  • Driving revenue growth through e-commerce, digital sales, partnerships, and innovative business development.

  • Identifying new commercial opportunities and transforming ideas into sustainable income streams.

  • Overseeing product development, pricing, merchandising, customer experience, and online trading.

  • Monitoring commercial performance through budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and financial planning.

  • Building strong relationships with suppliers, partners, sponsors, and key stakeholders.

  • Implementing effective systems, processes, and operational improvements to support growth.

  • Supporting young people by creating opportunities for them to gain experience and develop commercial and employability skills.

  • Ensuring all commercial activities operate to high legal, financial, and ethical standards.

Skills

We're seeking someone who combines commercial thinking with a passion for making a difference.

You'll ideally have:

  • Experience launching, growing, or managing a commercial business or trading operation.

  • A strong background in e-commerce, online retail, digital sales, or commercial strategy.

  • Excellent commercial awareness with experience identifying and developing growth opportunities.

  • Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the confidence to work independently and take ownership.

  • A practical, hands-on approach to solving problems and delivering results.

  • Experience within a charity or social enterprise is welcomed but certainly not essential.

Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you only are a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth

We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

  • Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions

  • Becoming a member of a strong network of likeminded individuals, spread across the UK, who you can connect with and collaborate with both within and outside of the Charity

  • Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers

  • Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

The hiring process

Our hiring process typically has two stages

  1. Video or Written Application (when applicable)

  2. Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator for that role

Some roles will have extra stages but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.

Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

title: IGA Coordinator
description:
Job Summary:

The IGA Coordinator serves as a liaison between the facility and the United States Marshals Service (USMS) regarding prisoner-related matters. This position is responsible for gathering, maintaining, and updating prisoner information in the USMS Prisoner Tracking System (PTS), as well as assisting with prisoner designations, movements, documentation, and related administrative processes.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a liaison between the facility and the United States Marshals Service (USMS) regarding prisoner-related matters.

  • Assist with the implementation and processing of Judgment and Commitment Orders.

  • Assist in assembling and processing destination package requests and submitting required packages to the Bureau of Prisons (BOP).

  • Assist with quarterly verification of prisoner detainers.

  • Gather and maintain required prisoner documentation, including Prisoner Intake Forms (USM-129), Personal History Forms (USM-312), and other documentation as required by the USMS.

  • Update prisoner medical information in the USMS Prisoner Tracking System (PTS).

  • Update prisoner status in the PTS to accurately reflect their phase in the designation process.

  • Process prisoner designations received from the USMS.

  • Submit requests for prisoner movements (Form 106) to the Justice Prisoner and Alien Transportation System (JPATS).

  • Maintain accurate and timely records related to prisoner tracking and designation activities.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge Skills/Abilities:

Summary: We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Functional Consultant to lead the functional design, configuration, and continuous improvement of our D365 F&O platform. This role plays a critical part in translating business requirements across Finance, Supply Chain, and Commerce into reliable, well-governed ERP solutions that support a fast-scaling global beauty business.

The Functional Consultant will own end-to-end solution design for core F&O modules, drive fit-gap analysis, and partner closely with technical developers, 3PL and EDI integration teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, best-practice configurations. The role is central to maintaining a stable, high-performing ERP backbone across our retail, wholesale, and direct-to-consumer channels.

The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 F&O, multiple full-cycle implementations, strong functional expertise across Finance and/or Supply Chain modules, and a proven ability to run requirement workshops, author functional design documents, and support go-live and hypercare. A solutions-driven mindset, strong collaboration skills, and excellent communication are essential.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Solution Design & Configuration
  • Lead requirement-gathering workshops and translate business processes into functional design documents (FDDs) and fit-gap analyses.
  • Configure and maintain core D365 F&O modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, Inventory, Procurement & Sourcing, Sales & Marketing, and Warehouse/Inventory Management.
  • Design solutions for multi-company, multi-currency, and multi-legal-entity structures, including intercompany and financial consolidation.
  • Define financial dimensions, account structures, posting profiles, and number sequences aligned to business and audit requirements.
  • Apply Microsoft best practices and manage scope, change control, and design decisions across workstreams.
  • Implementation, Testing & Support
  • Deliver end-to-end implementation and enhancement projects – from configuration through UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
  • Author test scripts, coordinate user acceptance testing, and validate solutions against business requirements.

You'll help maintain laboratory quality standards by following safety protocols, documenting specimen information accurately, and assisting with equipment maintenance and supply inventory. Attention to detail is critical to ensure accurate testing and diagnostic results.

title: Principal Product Engineer
description:
About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.


Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com

Job Summary

We are seeking a curious, motivated, and talented Principal Product Engineer to accelerate the development and deployment of SiTime’s MEMS-based timing products. The Principal Product Engineer will be responsible for driving continuous improvements on one or more products in production to ensure high yield and high quality while reducing product cost. This role expects the engineer to be adept at utilizing statistical methods for analyzing large datasets to identify yield issues and work with cross-functional engineering team members to resolve them. This position is ideal for an engineer with strong analytical capability, deep understanding of semiconductor/MEMS device behavior, and experience maintaining complex mixed-signal or MEMS products in mass production. Candidates with experience in Systems Engineering, Silicon Characterization, Circuit Design or MEMS Design are preferred. Qualified candidates can be a graduate in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.

Responsibilities

  • Lead product engineering activities from concept through high-volume ramp for MEMS oscillators, resonators, and timing ICs.
  • Analyze large datasets to assess product performance across process, voltage, temperature, and reliability stresses.
  • Partner with test engineering to develop efficient and robust production test solutions.
  • Drive root-cause analyses and problem-solving for device performance and yield issues during development.
  • Monitor production performance, yields, and outgoing quality; identify trends and drive continuous improvement actions.
  • Collaborate with foundry, assembly, and test partners to resolve process and equipment-related issues.
  • Implement design-of-experiments (DOE) to optimize parameters, improve yield, and reduce test cost.
  • Ensure robust product release through documentation, risk assessments, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Support customer engineering teams with debug, field returns, and technical inquiries.
  • Interface with operations for supply chain readiness, lifecycle management, and cost-reduction initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in Product Engineering, Semiconductor Device Engineering, or MEMS technology.
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Exensio, JMP, MATLAB, Python).
  • Experience with high-volume manufacturing, ATE test flows, and statistical process control (SPC).
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional technical initiatives to closure.

Preferred

  • Strong understanding of MEMS resonators, timing architectures, oscillators, or mixed-signal ICs.
  • Experience with MEMS fabrication processes, wafer-level packaging, or thin-film materials.
  • Background in timing products (TCXO/OCXO/MEMS oscillators).
  • Familiarity with failure analysis techniques such as SEM, FIB, XRD, and electrical debug.
  • Experience with automotive or industrial qualification standards.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Ability to manage ambiguity and deliver in fast-paced environments.
  • High ownership mindset with attention to detail.

Compensation Range:

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.

title: Contract Negotiator
description:
Primary Function of Position:

The Contract Negotiator is key in Intuitive's commercial contracting. As the main communicator for sales contracts, the Contract Negotiator works with Intuitive's salesforce, leadership, internal management, over 10 departments, and customers for compliance and mitigation of risk in commercial contracts. The Contract Negotiator handles tasks like contract drafting, negotiating, and finalizing commercial contracts. This is done professionally in a high-pressure environment with tight deadlines.

Responsibilities:

Contract Drafting and Negotiation. Prepare, review, and negotiate complex customer contracts, including sales agreements for Intuitive's products and services. Act as a point of contact for digital, data, and privacy agreements, including Business Associate Agreements.

Research. Stay updated on changes in the medical device industry affecting customer contracts. Provide recommendations and guidance based on industry best practices.

Cross Functional Collaboration. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, like Business Development, Product Marketing, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, Service Department, Field Service, Manufacturing, and Executives. Understand business goals, incorporate Legal’s advice, and negotiate favorable terms. Prior to commercial launch of a new product, review and assess the impact of the new product on existing agreements or agreement templates. Coordinate drafting of or implement new agreement templates prepared or approved by Legal to support new products. Interface with external parties, including customers, regulators, and affiliates.

Risk Management. Identify and escalate potential legal risks in contracts and collaborate with Legal to mitigate them. Manage risks and confirm compliance with company policies designed to operate within applicable laws, regulations, and ethical standards.

Contract Lifecycle Management. Manage the entire contract lifecycle, from drafting to execution and termination. Ensure timely renewal, amendments, and compliance. Work closely with Legal, Sales, Customer Service, Accounting, and Logistics teams on the system sales process. Collaborate with Marketing, Clinical Affairs, and Market Access on further contractual activities.

  • Law degree (JD) from an accredited law school or equivalent legal experience.
  • 3+ years’ experience with commercial contracts, or equivalent transferrable skillset from in-house or law firm setting.
  • Working knowledge of contractual terms and conditions, HIPAA, data security, or data privacy regulations.
  • Exceptional contract drafting and negotiation skills with a keen attention to detail, preferably commercial terms and conditions.
  • Exceptional interest in commercial transactions, financial activities, and business decisions. Ready to work closely with a dynamic and energetic salesforce.

title: Construction - Billboard Installer
description:
Would you like to see a different part of your city every day from a bird’s eye view? This job is action-packed, and we provide all the training and equipment to start your full-time career. Our Lamar office in South Bend, Indiana is now hiring a new Operations crew member to help us bring outdoor advertising campaigns to life for brands in South Bend, IN and the surrounding areas.

The purpose of this entry-level, full-time position is to install and maintain billboards, including installation of advertisements, maintenance of structures, and the construction upkeep of billboard cosmetics. This position most often works alone and must be able to manage work schedules effectively.

Why Lamar?

Want a career that takes you above the everyday? As part of Lamar’s billboard construction and operations crew, you’ll experience the city from a bird’s-eye view while building and maintaining the structures that keep communities informed. Join a team that values safety, teamwork, and adventure—every single day. See our operations crew in action over on YouTube.
Lamar is a certified Great Place to Work, with 88% of employees in agreement. Lamar Advertising has also been named as a “Best Company to Work For” in U.S. News & World Report’s annual ranking.
  • Learn more about us on our official YouTube channel.
  • Check reviews and company updates on our Glassdoor page
  • Learn more about our Great Place to Work certification.

    What you can expect from us:

    • A Monday - Friday, 6:00 am - 2:30 pm work schedule
    • An hourly range of $20 - $22 / hour, dependent on relevant experience and qualifications
    • 120 hours of paid time off (PTO) that increases with tenure
    • 12 paid company holidays, including President's Day and Juneteenth
    • A comprehensive 90-day training program
    • Career advancement opportunities
    • Ongoing professional development and internal leadership programs to maximize your career potential
    • Multiple medical plan options and health savings account
    • Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident coverage
    • Short & long-term disability and paid parental leave
    • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
    • 401k plan with company match
    • Up to $1,200 value in employer-paid HSA contributions and cash rewards for engaging in our wellness program
    • A people-first culture that invests in connection, community involvement, and transparency around employee feedback

    A Day in the Life:

    As an Installer, you can expect to work alongside the Operations team to install and maintain billboards while prioritizing the safety of yourself and others. Installation most often includes handling a large advertisement printed on vinyl and ensuring it is properly assembled to the billboard structure. The tallest billboard structure in the company is around 200 feet, so comfort with heights is a must.

    Maintenance of our billboards includes construction work such as tightening bolts, painting steel structures, repairing trim and various parts of a billboard sign face and structure, changing light bulbs, and more. As for power/manual tools: you bring the experience, we bring the equipment!

    In this role you'll be expected to:

    • Remove and hang flexes from billboards, remove and hang vinyls, cut and prepare flexes and vinyls for installation, cut, prepare and install copies on Tri-Visions
    • Build and install extensions on billboards, cut brush/weeds, conduct storm damage repairs and minor electrical repairs, and maintain a clean workshop area
    • Use power/manual tools while adhering to safety regulations
    • Attend installer and construction safety meetings as required
    • Maintain operation vehicles; maintain construction tools, equipment, and machinery
    • Take completion photos for proof of performance of installations

    What we're looking for in YOU:

    • Ability to work alone and manage your work schedule effectively
    • Willingness to work at heights up to 100 feet above the ground
    • Strong communication skills. Ability to speak and read English fluently.
    • Willingness to work and get along well with others
    • Basic computer skills including Internet navigation and Microsoft Word & Excel.
    • Ability to work from ladders and to carry a ladder and/or other tools to the worksite from vehicle.
    • Working knowledge of electrical skills and techniques.
    • Working knowledge of fabrication skills and techniques.
    • Skill in reading technical documents, such as blueprints and diagrams.
    • General knowledge of Lamar, Department of Transportation (DOT), and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) safety regulations
    • Ability to safely use construction equipment
    • Ability to climb heights and work at heights above ground safely
    • Ability to document installations, through photographs and written logs
    • Skill in the practical applications of mathematics, in relation to construction and operations tasks
    • Skill in setting priorities that accurately reflect the relative importance of job responsibilities

    Education and Experience Requirements:

    • A high school diploma or equivalent is required
    • A valid driver’s license is required.
    • Ability to complete OSHA 10-hour Construction course required
    • CDL and Non-CDL licenses are a plus, but not required!
    • Previous experience working at heights up to 200 ft. above ground preferred
    • Construction and/or billboard installation experience a plus, but not required

title: Consumer Insights Intern
description:
Your Story.

Do you have a passion for understanding consumer behavior and translating it into marketing actions? Do you want to learn more about consumer insights and marketing within the world of CPG food? Are you interested in working for the leading brand in natural cheese and snacking? We are looking for talented people who are enthusiastic, analytical, collaborative, and keen observers of human truths. You are a leader who has emotional intelligence, analytical skills and are a critical thinker. As a member of the Insights Team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of research and analysis to support initiatives critical to company growth. You are excited to explore the challenging world of CP Insights and hope to find a company you can build a career with after graduation.

Your Passion. Our Culture.

At Sargento, you work for a company you believe in, with a family of people who believe in you. Our culture stems from a simple premise: Hire good people and treat them like family. At Sargento, you can make decisions based on how they affect people as well as the long-term health of our company. You will be encouraged to make a meaningful difference in the community, in the company and in your career. With diverse experiences and tools to learn and develop, you can transform your aspirations into reality. If you’re ready for the right place to belong and grow your career, you can find it here.

Benefits That Set Us Apart.

  • Lead and own real and relevant projects aligned with business objectives
  • Gain valuable skills and experiences to be prepared for entry level opportunities
  • Mentorship and career development to learn and grow personally and professionally
  • Volunteer in community service activities
  • Social professional networking experiences
  • Flexible work week onsite Mondays through Thursdays and optional remote Fridays; plus, half day Fridays
  • Nationally competitive compensation
  • Paid relocation and housing
  • 5 unpaid days off for interns and 10 unpaid days off for co-ops
  • 401(k) employer contribution top 1% in the nation
  • Discounts at the company cheese store and local attractions/events

Skills You Will Develop.

  • Communication
  • Critical Thinking
  • Collaboration
  • Cross-Functional
  • Professionalism
  • Leadership
  • Technology
  • Time Management

What You Do.

  • Contribute to the sourcing, interpretation, and application of consumer information to address the needs of business partners as directed by the Senior Consumer Insights Manager-FSI.
  • With guidance from the Senior Manager, design and execute at least one custom research project, developing actionable insights and reporting the results to stakeholders. Areas of research may include advertising, concept, product, packaging, positioning, pricing, need state and consumer segmentation, and syndicated data analysis.
  • Help monitor and apply consumer trends (demographic, attitudinal, behavioral) to the business.
  • Participate in training on Circana (syndicated sales and household panel) data.
  • Display collaboration with cross-functional teams and excellent influencing skills. Share information across the Insights team.

Your Education and Qualifications.

  • Pursuing a business degree with a personal passion for market research, all things food, analyzing data and marketing, having completed sophomore year prior to starting internship.
  • Curious; always wants to understand the ‘why’ behind something. Interested in human behavior and how consumers make decisions.

  • Team-oriented; enjoys growing with other team members

Our Story.

With over 2,400 employees and net sales of $1.8 billion, Sargento Foods is a family-owned company that has been a leader in cheese for more than 70 years. We created the world’s first, successful pre-packaged sliced and shredded natural cheeses. Sargento is based in Plymouth, Wisconsin, where we manufacture and market shredded, sliced and snack natural cheese products, as well as ingredients and sauces. Sargento is known for the exceptional quality of our products and for product design, packaging and merchandising innovations that have transformed our industry.

To learn more about our culture and values, please visit our website at https://careers.sargento.com/us/en.

title: Field Technician, Mobile Gas Leak Detection
description:
Heath Consultants Incorporated

Since 1933, Heath Consultants has been a trusted leader in protecting communities through natural gas safety services. We are hiring motivated individuals to join our team as Mobile Gas Leak Detection Technicians. No prior experience is required — we provide paid training and industry-recognized certifications.

If you’re dependable, enjoy working outdoors, and want a stable career with purpose, this could be a great fit.

Position Overview

The Mobile Gas Leak Detection Technician (AMLD) operates company vehicles equipped with advanced mobile leak detection (AMLD) technology to identify, record, and report potential gas leaks throughout designated survey areas. This position plays a critical role in ensuring public safety and environmental protection by supporting utility clients in the detection and prevention of natural gas emissions. THIS POSITION IS OVERNIGHT!!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Operate a company vehicle outfitted with the AMLD system to survey assigned routes. (OVERNIGHT ONLY)
  • Follow daily schedules and GPS-guided mapping to complete survey coverage efficiently.
  • Monitor AMLD software and instrumentation for gas leak indications while driving.
  • Accurately document leak indications, GPS coordinates, and environmental conditions using handheld or onboard systems.
  • Notify supervisors of confirmed or suspected leaks per company and client protocols.
  • Maintain AMLD equipment and vehicle cleanliness; perform basic troubleshooting when necessary.
  • Adhere to all company safety policies, traffic regulations, and worksite procedures.
  • Participate in safety meetings, training, and certification renewals as required.
  • Support other leak detection, survey, or inspection activities as assigned.


Qualifications and Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent (GED).
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Must be able to work independently and safely during overnight hours.
  • Basic computer proficiency (Windows, tablets, GPS systems).
  • Ability to learn and operate specialized leak detection equipment and software.
  • Strong attention to detail, spatial awareness, and ability to follow routing instructions.
  • Excellent communication, observation, and reporting skills.
  • Willingness to travel and work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

No industry experience is necessary — we value work ethic, dependability, and a safety-first mindset.

Competencies:

  • Customer Focused / Customer Oriented
  • Makes good Decisions with Quality Problem Solving / Demonstrates Good Judgment

Work Environment:

  • Occasional bending, lifting, or walking required for equipment setup and verification checks.
  • Ability to work during nighttime conditions and tolerate varying environmental conditions (heat, cold, rain, etc.).

Benefits

  • Weekly pay

  • 401(k) with company match
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance

Many of our technicians advance into senior technician, field leadership, and safety management roles. Heath is committed to developing long-term careers, not just filling positions.

title: Director of Grants Development
description:
The Grants Development Office supports the Boston Public Health Commission (BPHC) in securing external funding to sustain and expand public health programs, services, and initiatives serving Boston residents. The Office works across BPHC bureaus and programs to identify federal, state, local, and private funding opportunities; assess their fit within BPHC priorities and capacity; develop competitive grant applications; and coordinate required internal review and submission processes. The Grants Development Director plays the lead role in all external grant and contract funding initiatives at BPHC. The Office works closely with BPHC Bureau and program leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), Project Directors, Finance and Post-Award Grants Accounting, and other BPHC departments throughout the grant lifecycle. This includes leading proposal and budget development, providing training and technical assistance to staff, award transition, renewals and continuation applications, amendments, progress reports, prior approval requests, and other sponsor requirements.

STRATEGIC GRANT DEVELOPMENT AND FUNDING

  • Identify and assess federal, state, local, and private funding opportunities that support BPHC programs, services, strategic priorities, and emerging public health needs.
  • Advise BPHC executive and program leadership on funding opportunities, grant requirements, competitiveness, organizational capacity, and potential financial or programmatic implications.
  • Stay current on changes in federal and state funding priorities, grant policies, regulations, and public health funding trends and communicate relevant developments to BPHC leadership and programs.
  • Work with program leadership and other stakeholders to assess community and program needs and determine whether proposed funding opportunities are appropriate for BPHC.
  • Lead or facilitate grant go/no-go decisions, considering program fit, staffing and operational capacity, budget requirements, sustainability, partnerships, and application timelines.
  • Track and ensure compliance with all external funding applications in development, renewals, and major funding deadlines BPHC-wide.

PROPOSAL DEVELOPMENT AND SUBMISSION

  • Lead the development of complex and high-priority grant applications, including federal, state, local, and private funding proposals.
  • Form and coordinate grant proposal development teams within BPHC that include subject matter experts from BPHC bureaus/offices and establish clear timelines, responsibilities, and internal review processes from concept development through final submission.
  • Work directly with program staff to develop project approaches, goals and objectives, work plans, evaluation plans, staffing structures, and other required application components.
  • Write, edit, and review grant narratives and supporting materials to ensure applications are clear, responsive, competitive, and consistent with funding requirements.
  • Collaborate with program staff and Finance/Budget staff to develop grant budgets and budget narratives that support the proposed scope of work while complying with BPHC and funder fiscal requirements.
  • Review applications for completeness, responsiveness, required approvals, formatting, and compliance with sponsor instructions before submission.
  • Assist with responding to requests for clarification, additional information, or pre-award documentation.
  • Ensure applications are submitted accurately and on time through Grants.gov and other federal, state, local, and private grant systems, including supporting grant leadership teams with funding renewals and reapplications.

GRANT POLICIES, REQUIREMENTS, AND COMPLIANCE

  • Interpret funding announcements, grant regulations, sponsor guidance, and award requirements and provide practical guidance to BPHC leadership and program staff.
  • Develop, maintain, and update BPHC policies, procedures, tools, and internal processes related to grant development and submission.
  • Provide guidance on federal and state grant requirements, allowable costs, indirect cost limitations, matching or cost-sharing requirements, subawards, contracts, consultants, and other proposal-related requirements in coordination with BPHC Finance.
  • Identify potential grant-related financial, operational, or compliance concerns during proposal development and bring significant issues to the appropriate BPHC leadership for resolution.
  • Manage and maintain BPHC registrations, user roles, and submission authority in federal, state, and local grant systems and ensure appropriate backup access and continuity.

PROGRAM AND POST-AWARD COORDINATION

  • Coordinate the transition of newly awarded grants from proposal development to program implementation and post-award grant management.
  • Facilitate or support initial grant award meetings to ensure PIs, Project Directors, program staff, Finance/Post-Award Grants Accounting, and other responsible departments understand the approved scope, budget, reporting requirements, restrictions, and key award conditions.
  • Work collaboratively with Post-Award Grants Accounting and program teams on grant amendments, continuation and renewal applications, carryover requests, no-cost extensions, prior approval requests, progress reports, and other sponsor actions requiring Grants Development support.
  • Provide technical assistance to PIs and Project Directors in interpreting grant terms and conditions, sponsor requirements, and changes that may require funder approval.
  • Review multi-year grant commitments and proposed program changes for potential budget, sustainability, or funding implications and advise program and BPHC leadership as appropriate.

STAFF LEADERSHIP AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE

  • Provide leadership, supervision, and direction to Grants Development Office staff, including setting priorities, assigning work, supporting professional development, and ensuring consistent quality and timely completion of work.
  • Provide technical assistance and training to BPHC staff on grant development, proposal planning, grant writing, sponsor requirements, and internal grant processes.
  • Develop practical templates, guidance, checklists, and other tools to improve consistency and efficiency in grant development across BPHC.
  • Build effective working relationships across BPHC bureaus, programs, and administrative departments to support coordinated grant development and problem solving.

BPHC LEADERSHIP AND ADMINISTRATION

  • Works to help BPHC advance as an antiracist organization by meeting or exceeding the standards set by the
    BPHC Anti-Racism Policy.
  • Maintain a strategic organization-wide view of upcoming grant opportunities by communicating regularly with BPHC-wide senior leadership.
  • Participate in BPHC-wide planning and leadership activities, including serving on the Senior Leadership Team as assigned.
  • Provide regular updates to the Executive Office and other BPHC leadership on external funding applications, awards, upcoming opportunities, funding trends, and significant grant-related issues.
  • Complete the Grants Development Office annual report and other reports summarizing external funding activity, funding outcomes, and office performance.
  • Oversee the Grants Development Office budget, reforecasting, administrative processes, staff timesheet approvals, and other management responsibilities.
  • Perform other duties consistent with the responsibilities of the position.

title: Sr. Principal Foundry Interface Engineer
description:
About SiTime


SiTime is the Precision Timing company.


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.


Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.


Job Summary

In this role, the candidate will support Foundry technical interface for SiTime. The key responsibilities include the following.

It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Foundry yield improvement through mitigation of systematic and parametric yield detractors
  • Manage Foundry yield excursion and implementation of Continuous Improvement Plan.
  • Manage Foundry safe launch
  • Provide technical guidance on Foundry Fab transfer projects
  • During development, direct wafer lot progress, process skew splits and DOE strategies
  • Support device performance analysis for mixed signal devices.
  • Manage compliance with fab yield, E-test, WAT, inline Cp/CpK metrics
  • Experience with AI/ML predictive modeling to improve projection accuracy for test chips and high-volume products, including correlation of inline process metrics with end-of-line yield and performance, is a plus.
  • Serve as technical liaison to the Foundries, communicate status of process health monitors to internal stakeholders, drive on time wafer out from the fab, continuous improvement deliverables and resolution of critical technical escalations.


Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Minimum requirements are a Master’s degree with 13+ years of experience or a PhD with 10+ years of industry experience in a relevant engineering or physical-science field, including Semiconductor Process Integration, Device Engineering, or Wafer Yield Engineering.
  • English proficiency is required, including the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and perform job responsibilities in a professional business environment.
  • Proven track record in yield pareto construction, modeling, projection, and the development of long-term yield roadmaps.
  • Experience in using PDF Exensio or other Big Data Analysis tools.
  • Extensive experience collaborating with foundries.
  • Experience in porting between fabs.
  • Expertise in interpreting complex product data (inline, e-test, and SORT) to drive organization-wide solutions.
  • Deep knowledge of semiconductor wafer inline inspection methods and SORT programs.
  • Deep knowledge of semiconductor device reliability
  • Well versed with DFM techniques and PFMEA
  • Experience in supporting semiconductor wafer fulfillment for products that require to meet Automotive AEC_Q100, ISO 26262 standards.
  • Strong Leadership and ability to set standards and drive to targets.
  • This position requires clear, accurate and timely communication both written and verbally.
  • Strong attention to detail, project management and organization skills, and ability to manage multiple projects at the same time in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.


Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Strong team worker within multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural environments. Show inherent sense of urgency and accountability.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal and team-work skills.
  • Highly motivated self-starter with a ‘can-do’ attitude, out-of-the-box thinking, with a willingness to take informed risks to achieve organization goals.


Compensation Range:


At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.


The annual base salary range for this role is $169,470 – $242,360. The final offer is determined by factors such as location, experience, education, and training.


In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.


Benefits offered: 401k plan, health and wellness that includes medical, dental, vision, life, parental leave, legal services, and time off plans.


SiTime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We treat each person fairly and we do not tolerate discrimination or harassment against anyone on the basis of any protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, political affiliation, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, or marital status or other characteristics protected by law. SiTime participates in the E-Verify program.

title: Lieutenant Hourly
description:
Job Summary:

The position of Lieutenant is responsible for performing supervisory functions in the facility as it pertains to the security and administrative control of the facility. Work involves scheduling, training, and supervising staff, as well as maintaining order and discipline among inmates, detainees, and offenders. Work under general supervision with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Organize and conduct inspections and searches of inmates, detainees, and offenders and their living and work areas.

  • Prepare records and reports as assigned.

  • Maintain logs and verify inmate counts.

  • Foster a team effort among correctional officers providing support, motivation, training, and assistance to them as required.

  • Report and investigate all unusual occurrences.

  • Direct the work of employees to ensure effectiveness.

  • Supervise daily routine of the security section.

  • Enforce post orders and ensure that correctional officers are familiar with shift assignments.

  • Handle disciplinary reports and prepare reports of disturbances and shift activities.

  • Function as shift supervisor as needed: supervise, instruct, train, and ensure the safety of assigned employees, inmates, detainees, and offenders; schedule employees, inmates, detainees, and offenders work and off-duty time; and assist in formulating security and work procedures.

  • Supervise and provide custody and security of inmates, detainees, and offenders including observing actions of inmates, detainees, and offenders, squatting and bending to perform “pat” and “strip” searches of inmates, detainees, and offenders; restraining and securing sometimes assaultive inmates, detainees, and offenders; and transferring and transporting inmates, detainees, and offenders by walking or riding in various vehicles such as trailers, vans, buses, etc.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
H3Zoom builds building-inspection and compliance software for the built environment. Our flagship product, Facade Inspector, is a full-stack web application combining a React single-page app with a Django backend, real-time features, drone and 360° imagery, geospatial maps, and 3D/BIM model viewing. Alongside it, our Site-Check compliance portal renders large-scale 3D datasets directly in the browser using three.js, served entirely from static cloud infrastructure. We're a small, high-ownership team looking for an engineer who wants to runthe whole stack, not just a slice of it.

Role Summary As our Full Stack Developer, you'll take end-to-end ownership of both production applications and the AWS infrastructure that serves them. That means the React SPA and its build pipeline, the Django/Channels backend and its real-time WebSocket layer, our companion Node/Express CommonDB service, and the AWS hosting and DevOps practices tying it all together. You'll bring structure and modern engineering practice — version control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code — to a codebase that's currently run by the founder with AI-assisted tooling, and you'll have real autonomy to shape how it's built going forward.

What You'll Work On

Frontend: Maintain and evolve the React (CRA) single-page app, including its code-split bundle structure, geospatial mapping (OpenLayers), and CAD/BIM viewing integrations (Sketchfab, Autodesk APS/Forge for Revit, Navisworks, and Inventor files).

Backend & real-time: Develop and extend the Django backend, including the Django Channels/ASGI real-time layer that powers live WebSocket features, served through Daphne and Nginx.

Async processing: Own the Celery, Celery Beat, and Flower job pipeline for background and scheduled work.

Integrations: Maintain the Node/Express CommonDB service and external integrations including Autodesk APS/Forge, Stripe, and Google Maps.

Cloud & DevOps: Manage and evolve our AWS footprint in ap-southeast-1 — EC2, ALB, CloudFront/OAC, S3, ACM, Route 53 — including migrating manual deployment processes into automated, reproducible pipelines.

Take ownership of the source code itself: import the React and Django repositories into Git and establish a proper branching and versioning workflow.

Tech Stack You'll Work With

Frontend: React (Create React App), code-split bundles, OpenLayers, Sketchfab viewer, Autodesk Platform Services (APS/Forge), Chart.js, Bootstrap 4, Font Awesome, Layer Technologies animate.css, toastr, jQuery, Stripe.js, Google Maps, Google Analytics, custom i18n (en/ms/id/de/pt/es/fr)

Backend & real-time: Django, Django Channels (ASGI), Daphne, Nginx reverse proxy, Django REST Framework token auth, Django admin

Async / jobs: Celery, Celery Beat, Flower, Redis/ElastiCache broker

Other services: CommonDB (Node.js/Express API on EC2), Autodesk APS/Forge OAuth integration

AWS / hosting: EC2, EBS (GP2-GP3), VPC/subnets/security groups, Application Load Balancer, ACM, CloudFront (OAC, CloudFront Functions), S3, Route 53

DevOps & tooling: Git, AWS CloudShell, AWS Budgets & Cost Anomaly Detection, S3 Intelligent-Tiering (current); GitHub Actions/OIDC, Terraform/CloudFormation (target state)

Must-Have Skills

Strong React experience, including Create React App projects: code-splitting, hashed asset builds, and client-side SPA routing.

Solid Python/Django experience; familiarity with Django Channels, ASGI, and WebSockets is a strong plus.

Working knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, S3, CloudFront, ALB, ACM, IAM, VPC, and Route 53.

Proficiency with Git and standard branching/versioning workflows.

A security-minded approach to frontend builds — comfortable identifying and removing browser-exposed secrets, fixing mixed-content issues, and excluding source maps from production.

Nice-to-Have / Bonus

Experience with Autodesk Platform Services / Forge, or CAD/BIM file formats (Revit, Navisworks, Inventor).

3D/WebGL experience, particularly three.js.

Celery, Celery Beat, and Flower for async job orchestration.

Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or CloudFormation.

CI/CD pipeline design, especially GitHub Actions with OIDC.

Payment integration experience (Stripe).

Geospatial mapping (OpenLayers) and multi-language i18n at scale.

Node.js/Express experience.

Containerization (Docker).

AWS Cognito, or AWS cost-optimization practices (Budgets, Cost Anomaly Detection, S3 Intelligent-Tiering).

Who You Are

You take genuine ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix next.

You're security-minded by default, not just when prompted.

You're pragmatic: comfortable balancing shipping speed against technical debt in an early-stage environment.

You communicate clearly and directly with a non-DevOps founder, translating technical tradeoffs into plain language.

You're comfortable working alongside AI-assisted development and DevOps workflows.

Why This Role This is a rare opportunity to take a live, revenue-generating SaaS product and architect its engineering foundations from the ground up — building the CI/CD pipeline, introducing Infrastructure as Code, and hardening production security — with full visibility into your impact and high autonomy over how the work gets done. You won't be one of many engineers maintaining someone else's system; you'll be the engineer who defines how this system is built and run going forward.

Equal Opportunity H3Zoom is committed to building an inclusive team and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. We evaluate candidates solely on their skills, experience, and potential contribution to the team.

title: Data Engineer (SQL/Hadoop)
description:
We are seeking for candidate to support a strategic data migration and reporting transformation initiative. The objective of the project is to migrate existing tables, datasets, and reports currently sourced from a legacy datamart and manual data sources to newly established enterprise data marts

The successful candidates will be responsible for analysing existing data processing and reporting logic, mapping legacy and manual data sources to the new data marts, redeveloping scripts and workflows, validating migrated outputs, and producing comprehensive data documentation. This role requires strong SAS, SQL and Python development skills, data analysis capabilities, and experience working with Hadoop-based data platforms

Job responsibilities Data Analysis & Discovery

Analyse existing tables, reports, datasets, and data processing workflows currently sourced from legacy data marts and manual processes

Review and understand existing scripts, transformation logic, data dependencies, and business rules

Identify data sources, data lineage, reporting requirements, and current-state processes

Engage business to understand existing reporting methodologies and requirements

Source Mapping & Migration

Perform source-to-target mapping between legacy data marts/manual sources and new data marts

Analyse and document field mappings, transformation rules, calculations, and business logic

Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for process optimisation during migration

Develop migration specifications and ensure alignment with business requirements

Development & Automation

Develop, enhance, and maintain SQL scripts using Hive and Impala engines via Hue

Develop scripts for data extraction, transformation, validation, and reporting processes

Rebuild existing tables, reporting datasets, and data preparation processes using the new data marts as source systems

Configure and support workflow scheduling and automation using Oozie

Ensure developed solutions are scalable, efficient, and maintainable

Data Validation & Testing

Perform reconciliation and validation between outputs generated from current sources and outputs generated from the new data marts

Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness

Investigate and resolve data discrepancies and defects identified during testing

Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and business validation activities

Ensure migrated reports and datasets meet defined business and technical requirements

Documentation & Governance

Produce and maintain project artefacts, including:

Source-to-target mapping documents

Data lineage documentation

Business and technical logic documentation

Metadata documentation

Data dictionaries

Reconciliation and validation reports

Technical specifications and operational runbooks

Ensure documentation complies with enterprise data governance and documentation standards

Job requirement

Strong SQL, SAS or Python scripting and data manipulation skills.

Hands-on experience with: Hue, Hive, Impala, Oozie

Experience in data warehousing, ETL development, data migration, or data engineering projects.

Experience working with large and complex datasets.

Strong understanding of relational databases and data modelling concepts.

Qualifications

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline

Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, ETL development, data warehousing, reporting, or data migration projects

Data Management Skills

Source-to-target mapping

Data lineage analysis and documentation

Metadata management

Data dictionary creation and maintenance

Data quality assessment and reconciliation

Technical and functional documentation

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Ability to understand and reverse-engineer legacy code and reporting processes

Good stakeholder engagement and communication skills

Ability to work independently and manage multiple deliverables within tight timelines

Preferred Experience

Experience in banking, financial services, or large enterprise environments

Experience working with Hadoop ecosystem technologies

Exposure to reporting transformation, data modernisation, or data migration programmes

Familiarity with enterprise data governance and metadata management practices

title: Data Scientist - Onshore (B)
description:
V4C is seeking a Data Scientist with strong experience in Databricks, Python, machine learning, and Master Data Management (MDM) to help build data-driven solutions that support healthcare and member engagement initiatives. The ideal candidate will have experience working with large, complex healthcare datasets and transforming disparate data sources into reliable, analytics-ready data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and productionize machine learning models, statistical analyses, and predictive analytics using Python and Databricks.
  • Build and maintain scalable data science workflows using Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, and related cloud data technologies.
  • Work with MDM processes and frameworks to establish consistent, accurate, and trusted master data across multiple source systems.
  • Analyze and resolve data quality, duplication, matching, and entity-resolution issues across member, provider, patient, and other healthcare-related datasets.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Product, Analytics, and business stakeholders to translate healthcare business problems into data science solutions.
  • Develop data validation, profiling, and quality-monitoring approaches to improve reliability of analytical datasets.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis and identify trends, patterns, and insights that can support member engagement and healthcare outcomes.
  • Contribute to feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and deployment of data science solutions into production.
  • Ensure data solutions follow applicable healthcare data privacy, security, and governance requirements, including HIPAA where applicable.
  • Document models, datasets, assumptions, methodologies, and data lineage to support reproducibility and governance.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and PySpark.
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills.
  • Experience developing and deploying machine learning or predictive models.
  • Strong understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts, including:
  • Data matching and deduplication
  • Entity resolution
  • Golden/master records
  • Data standardization
  • Data quality
  • Reference/master data
  • Experience working with large-scale structured and semi-structured datasets.
  • Experience with Delta Lake / Lakehouse architecture.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and data lineage.
  • Experience working with healthcare, payer, provider, patient, or other regulated data is preferred.
  • Experience working in a HIPAA-regulated environment is highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with healthcare member/patient data and healthcare data models.
  • Experience with MDM platforms such as Informatica MDM, Reltio, IBM MDM, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
  • Experience with MLflow or similar model lifecycle management tools.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics/visualization platforms.
  • Experience building production-grade ML/data science pipelines.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7, or claims data is a plus.

Core Skills
Data Science: Python, Machine Learning, Statistics, Predictive Analytics
Databricks: Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow
Data: SQL, Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Lineage, Data Modeling
MDM: Master Data Management, Entity Resolution, Matching, Deduplication, Golden Records
Healthcare: Healthcare Data, HIPAA, Patient/Member Data, FHIR/HL7
Cloud: Azure/AWS

title: Junior Project Manager
description:
Marks, part of the Propelis Group, Marks is a consumer experience agency creating engaging moments across the entire brand spectrum—from brand design and packaging, to content and consumer connections. We are a collaborative global network of 1,900+ team members across 25+ studios and 20+ countries, partnering with some of the world’s most recognized brands to solve complex business challenges through design, strategy, and craft.

Job Summary


The Project Manager is responsible for planning, organizing, and overseeing the execution of
projects within Marks. This role ensures that projects are delivered on time, within budget and
agreed margin and to the highest quality standards by coordinating teams, managing workflows, and
maintaining clear communication with clients. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented multitasker
who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and has a passion for creative excellence.

Key Responsibilities


1. Project Coordination

  • Develop project plans, schedules, and budgets in collaboration with the team and client.
  • Owns all gates, risk and commercial controls to run the project they are accountable for, for
    best utilisation, workflows, and delivery.
  • Own and track margins and optimisation solutions for the project they are accountable for,
    ultimately delivering to the target VCM
  • Manage day-to-day operations of assigned projects, ensuring smooth execution and delivery.
  • Track project performance in partnership with the PMO, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets,
    and resource allocation.
  • Collaborate closely with the PMO to ensure projects align with organizational goals and
    governance standards.
  • Maintain data integrity within project management tools like Workfront, ensuring accurate
    reporting and alignment with organizational objectives.

2. Team Collaboration

  • Act as the central point of contact for internal teams, including designers, strategists, and
    copywriters
  • Facilitate team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and status updates to ensure alignment and
    progress.
  • Help allocate resources effectively and flag any capacity or timeline concerns.

3. Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the client contact for assigned projects regarding delivery, providing regular updates
    and addressing questions or concerns.
  • Ensure alignment between client objectives and project deliverables.
  • Manage expectations and build strong relationships to foster trust and satisfaction.

4. Budget & Timeline Management

  • Monitor project budgets and margin, ensuring all costs are accounted for and within scope.
  • Proactively address scope changes, ensuring client approval and proper
    documentation.
  • Manage project timelines, identifying risks and adjusting plans as needed to meet deadlines.

5. Problem Solving & Risk Mitigation

  • Identify potential challenges and develop solutions to keep projects on track.
  • Escalate issues to the Senior Project Manager or Project Director when necessary, ensuring transparency.

6. Process Improvement

  • Contribute to improving project management workflows and tools for greater efficiency.
  • Document lessons learned and best practices for future projects.

  • Able to handle customer interactions and potential issues/concerns courteously and professionally
  • Use basic information-gathering skills to solve problems
