title: Horticulturist
description:
Job Summary:

Develops, implements and manages the South Carolina Aquarium’s horticultural projects including internal exhibits, external exhibits, off-site nursery and other plant displays.


Essential Functions:

  • Adhere to South Carolina Aquarium policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrate a love of working with South Carolina native plants.
  • Assist Curator in developing the horticulture program for the South Carolina Aquarium.
  • Oversee the daily care and aesthetics of all plant displays including all aspects of plant culture, rotation of plant material, management of animal interaction with plant material, etc.
  • Participate in research, design, modification and development of new exhibits/systems at the SCA and nursery.
  • Establish and cultivate relationships with local and regional plant resources.
  • Acquires and/or propagates all Aquarium plant material.
  • Manage off-site nursery facilities.
  • Develop and maintain off exhibit plant propagation and holding area (nursery) through normal nursery practices.
  • Maintain accurate records and reports.
  • Develop, execute and provide knowledge and expertise for field projects involving the use of existing or installed native plant material for habitat reclamation and enhancement.
  • Liaison with the City of Charleston for horticultural activities on National Park Service property adjacent to the Aquarium.
  • Helps develop and maintain budget for horticultural needs.
  • Manage the pest management program for SCA.
  • Assist with special projects as requested by the Curator.
  • Provide coverage for other animal care positions as required.
  • Be flexible with work schedule, being able to work weekends, holidays and evenings.
  • Work unsupervised and make decisions consistent with the team philosophy.
  • Train and supervise horticulture volunteers and interns, providing mentorship and support for the Aquarium’s internship program.
  • Adhere to all South Carolina Aquarium policies and procedures.
  • Assist aquarium staff and visitors as needed in a pleasant, professional and courteous manner.


Other Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Support the mission by participating in Aquarium sponsored programs and events on a regular basis.
  • Maintain inventory of supplies and equipment used in horticultural operations.
  • Cross-train in other areas of animal care.
  • Respond to visitor and telephone inquiries.
  • Keep abreast with current related literature.
  • Attend and makes presentations to professional conferences and meetings.
  • Participate in cross-functional activities like conducting tours, educational programs, member programs, committees, etc.
  • Work with and supervise outside contractors.
  • Liaison with the owners of nursery location.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong knowledge of the practices and principles of horticulture in a botanical garden setting and in botanical/zoological mixed species exhibits.
  • Knowledge of the flora and fauna of the Southeastern U.S., especially as it pertains to South Carolina native plant communities.
  • Skilled in all aspects of plant culture including watering, fertilization, pruning, pest management, plant propagation, etc.
  • Good organizational, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Knowledge of organic/natural pesticide and fungicide control.


Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Horticulture, Botany or related field, or the equivalent to a degree in experience
  • Minimum of three years' experience in a related field


Licenses & Certifications Required:

  • Valid Driver’s License
  • South Carolina pesticide license (or ability to acquire)


Supervision of Others:

  • Horticulture and other Animal Care volunteers
  • Interns


Physical Requirements:

Requires average walking, standing, bending, stooping, and crouching, climbing ladders, sitting, kneeling, balancing, pushing and pulling, crawling, working with tools, computer tasks and phone usage; should be able to lift/carry at least 50 lbs.; requires driving Aquarium vehicles.


Hazardous Requirements:

Average exposure to minor or severe cuts; falls; falling objects; hazards to eyesight, hearing and sense of smell; and tight spaces. Often requires use of personal protective equipment due to exposure to chemicals, hazardous materials, ozone, and handling of animals.


Working Conditions:

This position requires works in both an office environment and outdoors, sometimes in extreme weather including both hot and cold; requires weekend and late-night work as needed; requires contact with customers, the general public, and outside vendors; requires carrying a cell phone and radio; requires occasional travel.

title: Senior Program Manager, HIV Care Innovation and Rapid Start (HIV/STI Division - Infectious Diseases Bureau)
description:
The Ending of the HIV Epidemic (EHE) initiative supports high-impact strategies to diagnose, treat, prevent, and respond to HIV. Rapid Start is a key treatment strategy that connects people newly diagnosed with HIV and people re-engaging in care with timely HIV medical care and antiretroviral therapy (ART).

Rapid Start relies on coordinated clinical and community systems to support linkage, navigation, treatment initiation, retention in care, and viral suppression. The HIV/STI Division provides programmatic oversight of EHE-funded Rapid Start activities, including contract management, provider coordination, technical assistance, performance monitoring, fiscal oversight, and compliance with federal grant requirements.

Under the direction of the Director of Prevention and Early Intervention, the Senior Program Manager manages the day-to-day programmatic and operational activities of the Rapid Start initiative. The position oversees implementation of the service model, assigned staff, contracted providers, performance management, quality improvement, community engagement, and required grant reporting. The Senior Program Manager works across clinical and community settings to reduce barriers and improve timely linkage to care, ART initiation, retention, and viral suppression.

Duties

  • Works to help BPHC advance as an antiracist organization by meeting or exceeding the standards set by the BPHC Anti-Racism Policy
  • Supervise and provide guidance to assigned staff supporting Rapid Start and related EHE activities.
  • Collaborate with clinical providers, community-based organizations, testing programs, public health partners, people with lived experience, and other stakeholders to plan, implement, monitor, and evaluate Rapid Start activities.
  • Work with program, fiscal, grants, contracts, data, evaluation, quality management, and subrecipient management staff to ensure programmatic and fiscal accountability.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, referral workflows, service standards, escalation pathways, and implementation tools.
  • Oversee contracted services, provider deliverables, expenditures, and data related to referral, linkage, ART initiation, retention, and viral suppression.
  • Provide technical assistance to funded providers on program implementation, grant management, performance expectations, and reporting requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable EHE, HRSA, federal grant, privacy, and BPHC requirements.
  • Establish and monitor performance indicators and outcome measures across the HIV care continuum, including timeliness, service quality, and equity in outcomes.
  • Develop and coordinate procurement processes and Requests for Proposals for Rapid Start and related services and participate in negotiations with selected vendors.
  • Coordinate performance monitoring, fiscal review, site visits, corrective action, technical assistance, and compliance reporting for implementing partners.
  • Convene provider meetings and learning collaborative activities and lead cross-system problem-solving to address barriers to linkage, treatment initiation, re-engagement, and retention.
  • Exercise independent judgment and discretion in decisions affecting Rapid Start operations, contracted services, staff, and implementing partners.
  • Work in a confidential capacity and operate with significant independence.
  • Make and recommend management and personnel decisions for assigned staff, including promotion, transfer, assignment, and discipline.
  • Prepare grant applications, progress reports, presentations, and other required program and federal submissions.
  • Perform other duties as required.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Join Our Team!

At Tomarco Contractor Specialties LLP/ ISAT Total Support, our employees are thriving both inside and outside the office. Our rapid growth is not only because of what we do, but how we do it. It’s simple: our employees are our greatest asset!

INTRODUCTION:

ISAT Total Support (Tomarco Contractor Specialties LLP) is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our dynamic project team. This role requires strong leadership, advanced project planning capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple complex projects from initiation through completion. You will play a key role in driving project execution, coordinating cross-functional teams, and partnering with engineers, sales, and customers to ensure successful delivery. Your strategic mindset, communication skills, and commitment to excellence will directly support project and companywide initiatives.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

  • 401(k) Program with company match

  • Accelerated growth opportunities
  • Exposure to major construction projects
  • Nationwide company with multiple branches
  • Rewarding, fast-paced work environment
  • Inclusive and diverse culture
  • Robust internal training and learning portal


YOUR CAREER STARTS HERE!

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Project Manager leads project planning, coordination, and execution to ensure successful delivery of customer solutions. This role oversees project timelines, budgets, resources, and communication, proactively identifying risks and driving resolutions to keep work on track. The Project Manager works closely with internal teams, clients, and field personnel to maintain alignment, uphold quality standards, and support continuous improvement across all phases of a project.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and manage assigned projects from kickoff through completion, ensuring scope, schedule, and budget compliance.
  • Coordinate with internal teams including engineering, VDC, estimating, procurement, and field operations to ensure seamless project execution.
  • Maintain and manage project information within Nexus and related project-tracking systems (logs, submittals, RFIs, schedules, documentation).
  • Oversee procurement activities by reviewing Material Requests, confirming quantities, monitoring lead times, and addressing shortages or backorders.
  • Support and lead technical coordination with engineers and clients—review drawings, clarify requirements, and ensure proper interpretation of seismic/engineering specifications.
  • Develop, maintain, and adjust project schedules; identify risks, delays, and required recovery efforts.
  • Prepare, manage, and track change orders, ensuring proper documentation and communication of cost and schedule impacts.
  • Maintain strong customer communication, facilitating updates, meetings, and action items to support client satisfaction and project transparency.
  • Track project budgets, cost-to-complete, billable hours, labor allocation, and progress billing to ensure accurate and timely invoicing.
  • Monitor job profitability, efficiency, and procurement performance using analytical and forecasting methods.
  • Support field teams by coordinating installation requirements, sequencing, and necessary project support details.
  • Lead project closeout, ensuring all documents, O&M manuals, as-builts, and financial components are completed.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to the development of project-management best practices at ISAT.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Management, or a related discipline (or equivalent construction experience).
  • 5–10+ years of experience in project management within construction, mechanical/electrical systems, seismic bracing, or a related industrial field.
  • Strong understanding of construction documents, engineered drawings, industry codes, and installation requirements (experience with seismic bracing or support systems preferred).
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with project-management and documentation tools (Nexus experience preferred).
  • Demonstrated ability to create, interpret, and manage construction schedules.
  • Experienced in managing budgets, cost controls, procurement processes, and project financial reporting.
  • Strong communication and customer-facing skills, with the ability to solve problems and represent ISAT professionally.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational capabilities.

Ability to travel to job sites or customer locations as needed.

Further Qualifications – The successful candidate must pass a background check.

title: Production Planner
description:
SUMMARY:

The production planner's responsibilities include supporting customer requests, providing excellent customer service, handling all tasks related to order management, monitoring inventory levels, regularly providing production status updates to management, and facilitating the timely delivery of products to customers. You should also be able to closely monitor the production process to ensure that production orders are completed on time and within budget.

To be successful as a production planner, you should be able to communicate effectively both internally and externally, be knowledgeable of material requirements planning, able to manage production deadlines, and evaluate demand change impacts. Ultimately, an exceptional production planner should demonstrate excellent time management, organizational, and problem-solving skills to ensure that production operations run smoothly.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Communicates daily with customers and handle all order requests, change requests, and field/direct general request from customers.
  • Evaluates, reviews, and confirms purchase orders accurately and create suitable production schedules.
  • Performs order management including receiving, reviewing, and entering/rejecting customer orders as well as managing order change requests.
  • Estimates the amount of material, equipment, and labor required for production.
  • Addresses and resolves production issues promptly to minimize delays in production.
  • Coordinates production operations in accordance with material, labor, and equipment availability.
  • Works with sales and operations to find win-win solutions for both our customers and Crenlo.
  • Provides recommendations for viable solutions to reduce production costs as well as improve production processes and product quality.
  • Executes changes to production schedules to ensure that production deadlines are met.
  • Compiles status and performance reports and submits them to management in a timely manner.
  • Informs the relevant departments promptly of changes to current production schedules.
  • Works with Cost Estimating and Sales to provide service quotes to customers as needed.

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:

  • Effective communication skills (both written and verbal); strong professional phone and email etiquette.
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to work with team members, customers, and suppliers
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Self-motivated and can complete tasks on time and with little supervision.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • Intermediate analytical and mathematical skills
  • Proficient knowledge and experience of Microsoft Excel, Word and ERP purchasing systems.
  • Intermediate knowledge and application of purchasing cost reduction methods
  • Proficient knowledge and experience with material requirements planning (MRP) systems.
  • Working knowledge of purchasing terminology and practices

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business management, or related field is preferred.
  • Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM) accreditation or other relevant certification is advantageous.
  • Proven experience working as a production planner. Minimum 2 years’ experience.

WORKING CONDITIONS/OTHER:

  • Work Hours/Status: Full-Time, 40+ hours, Monday – Friday
  • Travel Requirements: Less than 10%
  • Environment: Works in an office environment within a manufacturing plant facility.
  • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal and state employment law, compliance, trends, new technologies and best practices in areas of responsibilities.

This position description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and competencies required of this position. Employees are held accountable for all aspects of the job, which are subject to change at any time. An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Crenlo offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision and life insurance. In addition to paid time-off and paid holidays, employees are offered participation in the company 401K with match. Regular fulltime employees working 30 hours or more hours per week will be eligible to enroll on the 1st of the month after hire.

While our technology has evolved over the years, our concern for exceeding customer expectations has never changed.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
The Technical Project Manager brings deep technical expertise in infrastructure, database systems, and cloud platforms that the broader PMO does not otherwise have, and independently plans and manages complex technical initiatives, such as systems implementations, integrations, and data projects, from initiation through closeout. This role translates technical requirements from engineering and IT teams into actionable project plans, and serves as the primary liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure dependencies and constraints are clearly understood and managed. The Technical Project Manager applies PMO governance, methodology, and standards to complex technical work, proactively identifies and resolves risks and blockers, and delivers clear, technically-informed status reporting to leadership. title: Ai Data Engineer
description:
Descripción del trabajo

Key Responsibilities Specification-Driven Extraction Engineering

  • Design and maintain declarative extraction specifications—using Pydantic models, JSON schemas, or domain-specific languages—that describe exactly which fields to capture, their types, and validation rules.
  • Implement pipelines that translate these specifications into executable extraction plans, leveraging both classical (Scrapy, Playwright) and AI-augmented (LLM-based semantic parsing) backends.
  • Build reusable specification libraries for recurring data types (product prices, tariff codes, regulatory texts) to accelerate onboarding of new sources.
  • Design and implement autonomous data extraction agents that can make decisions about source selection, retry logic, and parsing strategies

Autonomous & Self-Healing Systems

  • Deploy self-healing spiders that automatically detect website layout changes and repair themselves using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers (e.g., Scrapy MCP Server, Playwright MCP).
  • Integrate semantic extraction (Scrapy-LLM, custom LLM pipelines) to eliminate selector brittleness—spiders rely on field descriptions, not fragile XPaths.
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents and orchestration systems.
  • Orchestrate complex, multi-step browsing workflows with agentic frameworks (BMAD/TEA, AutoGPT-like agents) that reason about page state, adapt to anti-bot measures, and correct their own behaviour in real time.

Platform Thinking & Reusability

  • Move beyond one-off scrapers: build a component-based extraction platform where selectors, login handlers, and pagination logic are shared, versioned, and tested.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and automatic rollback for failed extraction runs.
  • Champion ethical crawling by design—rate limiting, robots.txt respect, and compliance with GDPR/CCPA are built into the specification layer, not retrofitted.

Collaboration & Continuous Innovation

  • Partner with data scientists and domain experts to refine extraction specifications for complex, unstructured domains (e.g., legal texts, tariff classifications).
  • Evaluate and pilot emerging tools to push automation coverage beyond 90%.
  • Document and evangelise specification-driven best practices across the engineering organisation.

  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen

  • Familiarity with frameworks that give LLMs browser control (Playwright + MCP, BMAD/TEA) to handle complex, non deterministic crawling tasks.
  • Classical Scraping Fundamentals
  • Data Validation & Storage – Ability to define validation rules within specifications and land clean data into SQL/NoSQL databases or data lake

The position works throughout an active pulp and paper manufacturing facility and may be exposed to:

  • Chemicals and process materials

  • Confined spaces
  • Elevated work areas
  • Outdoor weather conditions

title: Sr. Engineer, Digital Design
description:
About SiTime


SiTime is the Precision Timing company.


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.


Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.

Job Summary


We at SiTime take pride in being the only company in the market that offers MEMS-based timing solutions. Our MEMS dies are uniquely complemented by our CMOS dies in the same package. We use state-of-the-art analog and digital circuits to achieve very aggressive design specs for our timing solutions. Our precision timing products keep pushing the boundaries of the industry across all dimensions and are by far superior to our competition. This has enabled us to continuously gain market share.

This has been achieved by pushing the innovation boundaries in MEMS and CMOS. Consisting of analog and digital blocks, our CMOS dies present unique technical challenges. The digital portion of our chips has been growing in the past few years and is expected to grow more rapidly in the upcoming years as our functionality and features scale up. To address our unique technical challenges, we are looking for a strong Senior Logic Design Engineer with a solid background in key digital design and implementation areas. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position.


Responsibilities:

  • Developing micro-architecture specification of the logic circuit from reading and comprehending the Product Requirement Document (PRD).
  • Developing the Register Transfer Level (RTL) design from the micro-architecture specification using Verilog or SystemVerilog as the HDL.
  • Developing standalone test benches to verify the RTL behavior.
  • Writing and verifying SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) for a design.
  • Writing timing constraints and clock definition for synthesis and place and route tools.
  • Running industry-standard synthesis tools (e.g., Genus or Design Compiler) and being able to fix timing problems if they arise.
  • Understanding various design tradeoffs including timing/area/power and knowing how to improve them.
  • Reading and understanding the Static Timing Analysis (STA) reports from an industry-standard STA tool (e.g., Prime Time).
  • Cross-functional interactions and communication with various teams within SiTime including analog, verification, backend, system, and test engineering teams.
  • Post-Si bring-up, validation, and debugging.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in electrical engineering plus 5 years of relevant work experience in the industry.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Proficient in Verilog and SystemVerilog.
  • Expertise in digital logic design fundamentals such as clock divider circuits, multi-clock logic designs, CDC, FIFO, FSM, etc.
  • Experience in designing mixed-signal digital logic.
  • Basic understanding of Discrete time Signal Processing theory, FIR, and IIR filter design.
  • Solid experience in digital design flow including RTL design, synthesis, timing constraints, and STA.
  • Skilled in scripting languages Perl/Tcl/Python.

Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Ph.D. in electrical/computer engineering plus 3 years of relevant industry experience.
  • 2-5 years of experience in designing high-precision digital arithmetic logic and Digital Signal Processing.
  • 2-5 years of experience in designing Digital Phase-Locked Loops (DPLL).
  • Experience in complex FSM design.
  • Familiarity with MATLAB, Simulink, or any other high-level modeling tools.
  • Experience in low-power digital design flow.
  • Basic understanding of the Control Theory.

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.


In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.


SiTime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We treat each person fairly and we do not tolerate discrimination or harassment against anyone on the basis of any protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, political affiliation, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, or marital status or other characteristics protected by law. SiTime participates in the E-Verify program.

Learn More about SiTime: Review the Get to Know SiTime section of our career page to explore our culture, values, and what makes us unique.

  • Fabrication Knowledge – An Interview with Rajesh Vashist

title: Director of Public Sector Growth
description:
About Us:

At Kooth, our mission is to create welcoming, accessible spaces for personalized digital mental health care that empowers young people to thrive. Grounded in an early-intervention model, we help youth aged 10–25 build resilience, access timely support, and lead fulfilling lives. We are more than a digital service — we are a movement for inclusive, evidence-informed mental health care.

Our culture is rooted in our values: Alongside You, Flexible, Compassionate, Committed, and Safe. These guide everything we do - how we show up for young people, how we collaborate as a team, and how we build solutions that meet communities where they are. With Kooth, you’ll be part of something bigger than yourself: meaningful work with measurable impact.

We bring this mission to life through Soluna, California’s first-in-the-nation digital behavioral health service for 13–25-year-olds. Soluna removes barriers to care by providing nearly immediate access to 1:1 coaching, Care Navigation, and self-guided tools helping young people find real support, build resilience, and discover hope when they need it most. Together with state and local partners, we’re transforming access to mental health support for youth. Learn more at .

What We’re Looking For:

The Director will own revenue development across an assigned portfolio of public-sector pathways within Kooth’s priority and secondary markets, translating the broader Growth and Government Affairs strategy into direct contracting opportunities with organizations positioned to fund population-level access to Soluna.

The role will carry an individual revenue target while contributing to the broader market strategy led by the Regional VP of Growth & Government Affairs. Initial customer pathways will include state agencies, counties, large municipalities, higher education institutions, large education systems, and select local and regional public entities.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Own an assigned portfolio across Kooth’s priority and secondary markets, with accountability for progressing opportunities from initial development through signed contract.
  • Identify and develop direct revenue opportunities across state agencies, counties, large municipalities, higher education institutions, large education systems, and select local and regional public entities.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive decision-makers, budget owners, clinical and operational leaders, and other stakeholders critical to securing institutional investment.
  • Define and document the buyer, funding source, decision-making process, procurement requirements, competitive landscape, and contracting pathway for each active opportunity.
  • Lead institutional opportunities through business-case development, proposal, procurement, negotiation, and contracting, coordinating with Clinical, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and Operations as needed.
  • Identify opportunities where institutional investment can advance a broader priority-market strategy, including establishing an anchor funder, implementation partner, or proof point for future public-sector growth.

Requirements

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven ability to secure new funded institutional customers and manage complex enterprise sales cycles.
  • Demonstrated success delivering significant revenue through large-scale contracts valued at $500,000 or more.
  • Experience building and managing a qualified pipeline aligned with defined priority markets.
  • Strong track record of developing and presenting compelling formal proposals, business cases, RFPs, and RFIs.
  • Ability to qualify and validate opportunities by identifying funding sources, executive decision-makers, buying processes, and clear next steps.
  • Experience advancing multiple complex opportunities through negotiation, contracting, and final purchasing decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage relationships, insights, and successful approaches across multiple markets to create new commercial opportunities.

Benefits

What You’ll Get:

Compensation: The base salary for this role is $135,000 to 150,000 annually. We’re committed to transparency and value our candidates time, which is why we share salary ranges in all states—regardless of local requirements. Final compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including your education, experience, skills, and overall alignment with the role.

Kooth offers a competitive base salary and comprehensive benefits including:

  • Excellent Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Remote-first flexibility and work-from-home support
  • Paid parental leave
  • Learning & development opportunities
  • 8 Paid Holidays, plus two half-day holidays (Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve)

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Kooth is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and provides equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Reasonable Accommodations:

Kooth is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, sincerely held religious beliefs, or other protected reasons under applicable law. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact our HR team.

Ready to Join Us?

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact and be part of a team that values purpose-driven work, apply today. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital mental health care.

title: Data Engineer, Analytics (Singapore)
description:
As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building large-scale data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.

In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.

You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.

Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.

Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.

Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.

Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize and own the data architecture for multiple large-scale projects, while evaluating design and operational cost-benefit tradeoffs within systems
  • Create and contribute to frameworks that improve the efficacy of logging data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights in a meaningful way
  • Define and manage Service Level Agreements for all data sets in allocated areas of ownership
  • Determine and implement the security model based on privacy requirements, confirm safeguards are followed, address data quality issues, and evolve governance processes within allocated areas of ownership
  • Design, build, and launch collections of sophisticated data models and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different products or domains
  • Solve our most challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources
  • Assist in owning existing processes running in production, optimizing complex code through advanced algorithmic concepts
  • Optimize pipelines, dashboards, frameworks, and systems to facilitate easier development of data artifacts
  • Influence product and cross-functional teams to identify data opportunities to drive impact
  • Mentor team members by giving/receiving actionable feedback

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent
  • 4+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positions
  • 4+ years of experience (or 2+ years with a Ph.D) with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in a STEM field
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

title: Inventory Controller
description:
Primary Function of Position:

The Inventory Controller is responsible for analyzing, improving and maintaining optimal inventory health to support efficient operations and evolving business needs. This role requires strong analytics capabilities, clear communication, cross functional collaboration, sound judgement, and well-structured inventory planning. The controller drives accuracy, prevents shortages, identifies risks and supports continuous improvement across the supply chain.

Essential Job Duties:

Inventory Accuracy & Root Cause Analysis

  • Analyze recurring discrepancy patterns and implement proactive corrective actions.
  • Perform in-depth root cause analysis for complex exceptions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve material master related discrepancies.

Inventory Health, Monitoring & Optimization

  • Analyze inventory data to report trends, risks and opportunities from improvement.
  • Identify overstated quantities in the system that may impact production and prevent material shortages.
  • Monitor inventory levels to support operational reliability.
  • Identify and resolve expired or at-risk inventory.

Cross-Functional Issue Resolution

  • Investigate and resolve inventory issues related to stock transfer orders across internal plants.
  • Act as a liaison between Inventory Control and broader operation groups.
  • Support inventory impact of New Product Introduction life cycle projects.
  • Reporting & Communication
  • Prepare and present inventory reports, KPIs and insights to leadership and crossfunctional stakeholders.
  • Use data to influence decision-making and optimize inventory strategies.
  • Provide mentorship by sharing inventory knowledge and analytical insights with team members.

Process Governance & System Controls

  • Maintain Kanban systems that align with operational replenishment strategies.
  • Participating in UAT sign-off for system or process changes.

Continuous Improvement & Project Support

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to drive continuous improvement in Inventory Accuracy and processes.
  • Support operational readiness efforts, analytics projects and ongoing process enhancements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years in warehouse, inventory control experience
  • Analytical Skills: ability to interpret complex data, perform trend analysis, and translate insights in actionable recommendations
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills for reporting findings, and collaborating with stakeholders
  • Liaison Skills: Proven ability to work cross-functionally and coordinate between departments
  • Decision-Making Skills: sound judgment in evaluating options and recommending inventory actions under varying conditions
  • Organizational Skills: Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

Required Education and Training

  • Associate’s degree or the equivalent 5 years of experience in inventory management or related area.

Working Conditions

  • Ability to lift 35 pounds frequently each day.
  • Extensive walking and repetitive physical motion (squatting, bending, lifting) is required (at least 70% of hours worked).
  • Safe operation of all material handling equipment (forklifts, pallet jacks. Portable stairs etc.) with ISI Training and Certification

Preferred Skills and Experience

(As applicable - Specific skills, knowledge, and experience that are not required to perform the job, but are desirable to have)

  • Ability to multi-task.
  • Fanatically Organized.

SAP and Agile software experience preferred.

title: IT Support Engineer - Columbia, TN

In 1795, the federally chartered Bank of the United States entrusted American Bank Note Company with the mission of producing counterfeit-resistant currency for the young Republic. That legacy established ABCorp as a pioneer in secure printing and shaped our evolution into a global leader in secure manufacturing. What began with protecting America’s financial foundation now drives cutting-edge solutions that safeguard organizations worldwide.

Today, ABCorp operates at the intersection of authentication, payments, and secure access, embracing next-generation (including additive 3D) manufacturing to meet the demands of a digitally driven world. With more than 230 years of expertise, no one understands secure manufacturing and authentication better — or has done it longer. We maintain global reach and compliance across eight locations worldwide and are trusted by fintechs, financial institutions, healthcare companies, governments, and brands in more than 120 countries. We deliver end-to-end innovation through high-security, state-of-the-art facilities that incubate advancements in payments, secure access, and additive manufacturing.

Overview:

Key Responsibilities:


Infrastructure & Network

  • Run, terminate, test, and label network cables (Cat5e/Cat6, patch panels, keystone jacks, cable management).
  • Maintain and troubleshoot network switches, VLANs, and wireless access points.
  • Support firewall operations: troubleshoot connectivity, verify existing rules, and escalate complex issues.
  • Administer Windows Servers, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, backups, and patching.
  • Monitor system and network health to help prevent downtime.


End-User Support

  • · Provide Tier 1/Tier 2 support for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and peripherals.
  • · Image, deploy, repair, and maintain Windows/Mac workstations.
  • · Support onboarding/offboarding, including workstation setup and account provisioning as directed.
  • · Maintain IT inventory and hardware lifecycle.


Security & Access Control Support

  • · Support existing security controls and access control systems (e.g., endpoint protection, badge systems) by troubleshooting, escalating, and assisting with audits.
  • · Follow company security policies and help users comply.
  • · This role does not design or implement new security controls or access control policies.


Requirements:

  • · 2+ years in IT support, system administration.
  • · Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, and Windows 10/11.
  • · Familiarity with printers, scanners, laptops, and desktop hardware.
  • · Ability to support firewall and security operations.
  • · Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.


Recommended:

  • · CompTIA Network+, CCNA, or Microsoft certifications.
  • · Experience with virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V) and Office 365.
  • · MacOS support experience.

title: Endoscopy Technician
description:
Summary

Assist physicians with diagnostic, therapeutic, and emergency endoscopic procedures by preparing patients, equipment, instruments, and procedure rooms, maintaining sterile technique, operating and calibrating specialized equipment, monitoring patients, and providing support throughout procedures.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Perform the full spectrum of sterile techniques, setting up surgical trays, preparing and draping patients for surgery, and assisting with post-operative dressings.
  • Ensure surgical packs are cleaned and packed for sterilization after every procedure, to include restocking surgical supplies.
  • Maintain a clean, safe environment for the patient either by active participation in the cleaning of clinical spaces, operating rooms, and medical equipment, or by guiding other personnel in the environmental maintenance.
  • Attend and/or comply with all annual training classes required by the Command.
  • Assist the adult and pediatric Gastroenterologist (GI) or the Surgeon in various clinical, diagnostic, and therapeutic and emergency procedures. Serves as first assistant to the physician in esophagogastro-duodenoscopies (EGD), colonoscopies, flexible sigmoidoscopies, percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy tube placements, push enteroscopy, anoscopies, small bowel push enteroscopies, peritoneoscopies (PEG), liver biopsies, and single balloon enteroscopies, Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), endoscopic ultrasounds (EUS), paracentesis.
  • Assist with all types of dilations (i.e., Maloney dilations, wire guided Savary-Gillard dilations, and endoscopic balloon dilations).
  • Assist with esophageal or colonic stent placements.
  • Assist with endoscopic biopsies and polypectomies.
  • Independently set up and performs Capsule Endoscopy (esophageal or small bowel), and 24-hour PH studies.
  • Set up and operates the monitoring and recording devices. Independently performs esophageal manometry, which requires specific training and knowledge of esophageal anatomy and physiology, as well as basic ability to interpret testing.
  • Calibrate equipment as necessary to perform procedure.
  • Prepare a summary of the test results and forward the report to the physician.
  • Serve as first assistant to the physician in various specialized therapeutic endoscopic procedures such as Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangio-Pancreatography (ERCP) with possible therapies such as biliary stone extraction, biliary stent placement, and biliary drainage tube placements.
  • Coordinate with the Department of Radiology personnel to secure X-ray and fluoroscopy rooms. Also serve as first assistant to the physician in the specialized treatment of gastrointestinal bleeding.
  • Evaluate the patient’s condition and determine the proper treatment procedure, technique, and compatible instrument adjustments. Independently set up the electrosurgery unit and/or Argon/Plasma coagulator for therapies.
  • Interpret the physician’s instructions and, as required for certain procedures, draw medications, mix solutions, inject dyes, read graphic printouts, and prepare needles, syringes, catheters, and/or balloons. Recognize potential problems with patients.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must have an Associate’s degree.
  • Must have at least one (1) year of experience in gastroenterology services (endoscopy and colonoscopy) within the last two years.
  • Must have an Active BLS Certification.
  • Must obtain and maintain any necessary security access and/or background checks.

Desired Qualifications & Skills

  • A Certified Nursing Assistant, or Emergency Medical Technician certification preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of pharmacology, including drug classification and administration, patient responses, and common dosages.

Work Schedule

Full-time. May be required to work additional hours as needed to complete assignment or project. On-Call Hours: Will be required to report in-person to the MTF during on-call hours if needed. Shall provide on-call services between the hours of 1700 and 0700 Monday through Friday and 24 hours on Weekends and Holidays. Shall provide one week of on-call services approximately every 6 to 8 weeks.

Work Environment

Work is performed in clinical, endoscopy, and surgical procedure areas. Employee may be exposed to medical equipment, bodily fluids, infectious materials, cleaning and disinfecting agents, and varying levels of noise. Position requires frequent interaction with patients, physicians, nurses, and other medical personnel.

Physical Demands

Position requires frequent standing, walking, bending, stooping, reaching, and use of hands for handling medical instruments and equipment. Employee may be required to lift, carry, push, and pull medical equipment and supplies and assist with positioning or transporting patients. The position may require prolonged standing during procedures and the ability to respond quickly to patient emergencies. It is Katmai’s business philosophy and practice to provide reasonable accommodations, according to applicable state and federal laws, to all qualified individuals with physical or mental disabilities.

title: Optician
description:
VISION TO LEARN

Optician – Atlanta, GA

Location: Atlanta, GA

Compensation: $24-$29/HR+ Sign-on and Retention Bonuses

Position Title: Optician

Employment type: Full Time + benefits

Vision To Learn seeks compassionate, mission-driven opticians who want to make a tangible impact on children’s lives. As part of a mobile clinical team, you’ll provide high-quality eye screenings and help deliver glasses to students in underserved communities—removing vision barriers that affect learning and long-term opportunities. If you’re motivated by service and inspired by teamwork to work in a meaningful, community-focused setting, Vision To Learn offers a rewarding way to use your skills to change lives.

For more information about career opportunities and to see the impact of our work, please visit our website

Qualified applicants please apply through this direct link or through our website:

About Vision To Learn

Vision To Learn is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization providing vision screenings, eye exams, and glasses to K–12 students in underserved communities across the U.S. at no cost to them or their families. Using mobile vision clinics—optometric exam rooms on wheels—we bring essential eye care directly to schools and community centers so every child can see clearly and learn confidently.

Since 2012, Vision To Learn has provided more than 3.8 million vision screenings, 800,000 eye exams, and 630,000 pairs of glasses to children in need across the nation. Our mission is simple: if you can’t see, you can’t learn.

Who We Are

We are friendly, high energy, knowledgeable, and quality-oriented professionals committed to Vision To Learn’s mission. We approach our work with a value system of service excellence, empathy, integrity, open communication, empowerment, and an eagerness to help the communities we serve.

We are looking for an Optician like you to join our team with a positive, proactive attitude, and commitment to our mission.


Position Description

Vision To Learn is currently seeking a qualified candidate for a full-time Georgia Optician position. This is a field-based role supporting mobile vision clinics that serve students at schools, summer programs, and community-based sites throughout Georgia.

The Optician will primarily work during school-based hours, Monday through Friday, with occasional Saturdays throughout the year based on program and event needs. While most clinic operations occur during the school day, this position may also require occasional work outside of school hours to complete documentation, patient records, inventory management, scheduling support, and other operational responsibilities.

This role follows the academic school calendar and includes peak operational periods during the school year and summer programming. Candidates must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, mobile healthcare environment that requires flexibility, organization, professionalism, and strong customer service skills.

The ideal candidate is patient-focused, detail-oriented, comfortable working with children of all ages and abilities, and able to work independently while supporting a collaborative field team environment.

Key position responsibilities include

Patient Responsibilities

  • Oversee assigned mobile eye clinic operations and support efficient patient flow throughout the day
  • Conduct eye exam pre-tests while maintaining optimal professional and patient care standards
  • Take measurements, fit, and adjust frames for patients according to written optical prescriptions
  • Assist patients with frame selections to ensure proper fit, comfort, and patient satisfaction
  • Complete and prepare daily reports and documentation in a timely manner while meeting required deadlines
  • Make follow-up calls to patient caregivers for feedback and patient support as needed
  • Conduct vision screenings using a Welch Allyn Spot Vision Screener
  • Study, understand, and follow all Vision To Learn health and safety protocols
  • Provide a positive, patient-centered experience for students, school staff, and families at all times
  • Demonstrate the ability to effectively work with students of all ages, ranging from 4 to 18 years old
  • Be comfortable and equipped to work with students with special needs and varying behavioral, developmental, and communication needs
  • Maintain professionalism, patience, flexibility, and strong interpersonal skills in a fast-paced school and community environment
  • Communicate effectively and compassionately with children, caregivers, school staff, and team members

Clinic Responsibilities

  • Maintain optimal driver safety standards when driving, parking, and operating the mobile clinic vehicle
  • Set up the clinic daily, monitor and replenish inventory, and ensure all patient and administrative paperwork supports an efficient workflow
  • Load, secure, inspect, and fuel the vehicle as necessary
  • Keep the vehicle, clinic, and internal work areas clean, organized, and professional at all times
  • Ensure the mobile clinic remains stocked with necessary clinical, administrative, and operational supplies
  • Coordinate and assist with vehicle maintenance needs, including taking the clinic vehicle for washing, routine maintenance, repairs, inspections, and auto body shop appointments as needed
  • Promptly report vehicle concerns, maintenance issues, or supply shortages to management
  • Assist in maintaining the overall appearance, cleanliness, and operational readiness of the clinic vehicle for daily use

Additional responsibilities as needed


Who You Are

We are looking for Portuguese-speaking visual researchers, photographers, and annotators to create image-based evaluation tasks for advanced AI systems.

The work involves sourcing authentic real-world images, verifying image rights and provenance, researching subjects using tools such as Google Search, Google Lens, and reverse image search, and creating cropped, masked, or degraded versions that preserve enough clues for multi-step investigation. You will also prepare English-language prompts, grading criteria, and solution notes for each task.

  • Create cropped, masked, occluded, or degraded image versions that hide key identifiers while preserving realistic clues.
  • Write clear, time-bounded prompts in English without revealing the answer.
  • Create concise, objective grading criteria for each evaluation instance.
  • Document the correct identity, research path, supporting evidence, and expected answer.
  • Work with structured file-naming, shared Google Drive folders, and submission guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across multiple evaluation tasks.

  • Native or highly fluent Portuguese.
  • Strong working proficiency in English.
  • Strong local cultural knowledge, including non-touristy landmarks, universities, municipal buildings, and domestic media.
  • Comfortable conducting iterative visual and web research from partial image clues.

  • Basic image-editing skills for cropping, masking, and obscuring visual details.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write concise, objective evaluation criteria.
  • Comfortable using Google Drive and structured digital workflows.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Join Qutwo - Europe's private Quantum AI Lab, on our quest to bridge the gap between the classical and the quantum world. We partner with the most advanced and forward-thinking customers, solving fundamental real-world problems, side by side.

The best scientists and engineers in the world are drawn to one thing: a problem worthy of their ability. At Qutwo, we have one. We are a European AI lab for the quantum era, co-founded by pioneers behind IQM and Silo AI, with a team spanning MIT, UC Berkeley, Cambridge, and Carnegie Mellon, and backed by the founders of Skype, Hugging Face, Quantinuum, Supercell and many more. We work at the intersection of quantum computing, AI, optimization, and simulation — where the answers do not yet exist and the work genuinely matters.

We are seeking exceptional AI/ML Engineers. If you are a humble learner, not afraid of the unknown, we encourage you to apply.

Role Description

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will join our team in a full-time capacity, collaborating closely with our scientists, engineers, and customers. In this role, you will apply a blend of exploratory research and practical implementation to design production-grade LLM architectures and autonomous Agentic AI systems that solve complex, real-world problems and drive customer value.

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of designing, deploying, and maintaining end-to-end ML systems and production-grade LLM applications at scale. You have owned the transition from prototype to production-hardened service.

  • 5+ years of professional experience in ML/AI Engineering. You prioritize robust system design, observability, safety/guardrails, and "infrastructure as code" over one-off experiments.

  • Hands-on experience architecting Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent coordination, stateful workflow orchestration, autonomous decision loops, and complex action execution.

  • Strong background in LLM integration, including function calling/tool-use, structured output parsing, and advanced reasoning strategies.

  • Exceptional ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, translate business objectives into technical roadmaps, and uphold high standards for code quality and system reliability.

  • Experience leveling up high-performing engineering teams, conducting deep-dive code/architecture reviews, and fostering a culture of technical excellence.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

  • Deep experience in LLM infrastructure, including advanced RAG systems, model fine-tuning, agent memory architectures, and automated evaluation frameworks.

  • Proficiency with vector databases, distributed computing, and GPU optimization.

  • Familiarity with combinatorial optimization algorithms or the intersection of ML and Quantum Computing.

title: Principal Analog Mixed-Signal Design Engineer
description:

SiTime Corporation is the precision timing company. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power and better reliability. With more than 3 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit www.sitime.com.

Job Summary

The Principal Analog Mixed-Signal Design Engineer contributes to building precision timing circuits, leveraging SiTime’s industry-leading MEMS technology. These products have applications ranging from high-performance Networking and Communications Infrastructure to ultra-low power Mobile platforms, including wearable devices. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position.

  • Contribute to the architectural definition of the design and chip integration
  • Perform calculations, design and verification simulations to ensure building blocks meet specifications at the schematic level and after post-layout extraction, while fully provisioning for DFT and DFM
  • Work closely with Layout Engineers to validate proper layout, using all best-known methods
  • Document assigned blocks, and hold preliminary and final design review meetings
  • Actively participate in the chip bring-up, evaluation and characterization, with emphasis on owned blocks
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Characterization, Test, and Application Engineers on issues related to owned circuit blocks
  • Support other projects as needed by management or as business needs change

  • M.S. in Electrical Engineering or related field with minimum 12 years of related experience, or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with minimum 8 years of related experience
  • Excellent academic record with published research projects prototyped and proven in silicon
  • Detailed knowledge of CMOS circuits and noise analysis
  • Core expertise in one of the following areas:
    • Integer-N and fractional-N PLL
    • Sigma-Delta ADCs
    • Temperature sensor
    • Analog and digital filters
    • Quartz or MEMS oscillator
    • Sub-threshold circuits
    • Low noise regulator and bandgap
    • High-speed output drivers
  • Ability to oversee circuit layout for critical blocks
  • Knowledge of programming languages: MATLAB, VerilogA
  • Proficient in using Cadence analog design tools

Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Passionate, self-starter with a strong commitment to flawless execution
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills required
  • Ability to work well with others in a fast-paced collaborative team environment

title: Step Specialist Brooklyn
description:
ABOUT US

New York Edge is the largest provider of after-school and summer camp programs in New York City public schools. Each year, programs in academics, including STEM, the arts, sports and wellness, and college access, help 40,000 students develop leadership skills and succeed in school. Working parents count on our programs to provide safe and enriching environments for their children.

SUMMARY

New York Edge is seeking passionate and enthusiastic people to fill the role of Step Specialist. Step Specialists (Stepping or step-dancing) should have knowledge and experience in this form of percussive dance. They must be able to produce complex rhythms and sounds through a mixture of footsteps, spoken words, and hand claps. The Step Specialist should have experience teaching or performing in groups of three or more, often in arrangements resembling military formations. Additional knowledge in gymnastics, break dance, tap dance, marching, African and Caribbean dance, or stunts are preferred- but not required. title: Life Sciences Research Expert (Scientific Reasoning / AI Evaluation)
description:
Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs.

Role Overview

We are looking for experienced Life Sciences researchers and subject-matter experts to create advanced scientific reasoning tasks for an AI evaluation benchmark focused on biology and related disciplines.

This is a non-coding research role. The work centers on designing rigorous, self-contained scientific problems based on realistic experiments, biological data, figures, sequences, structures, literature-style evidence, and research scenarios. The goal is to create tasks that test whether AI systems can genuinely interpret evidence, reason scientifically, and synthesize information, rather than simply recall facts.

Relevant backgrounds include Molecular Biology, Genetics & Genomics, Cell Biology, Biochemistry, Neuroscience, Microbiology, Immunology, Evolutionary Biology, Ecology, Structural Biology, Biophysics, Developmental Biology, Cancer Biology, Pharmacology, and related fields.

CONTRACT: Contractor assignment, 6 weeks

COMMITMENT: Hourly, up to 40h/week

LOCATIONS: Remote - Argentina, Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Nigeria , Ghana, India, Indonesia, Turkey, Vietnam, Kenya, Pakistan, Chile, Peru, Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia, Nepal, Mexico

PROCESS: Application form -> 60 min online test (analyzing biochemical measurements and distinguishing among mechanistic defects in enzyme variants)

Key Responsibilities

  • Design challenging life-sciences reasoning problems for AI evaluation.
  • Create tasks based on realistic experiments, biological datasets, figures, sequences, structures, and scientific evidence.
  • Write questions with clear, objectively defensible answers.
  • Develop rigorous expert reference answers explaining the required scientific reasoning.
  • Ensure tasks test interpretation and synthesis, not simple factual recall.
  • Validate biological claims, calculations, assumptions, and conclusions.
  • Identify ambiguity, alternative valid interpretations, and poorly constrained questions.
  • Build tasks that meaningfully differentiate advanced AI models based on scientific reasoning ability.
  • Incorporate reviewer feedback while maintaining high quality and throughput.
  • Document tasks clearly and reproducibly where applicable.

Requirements

  • PhD, postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced research experience in the Life Sciences.
  • Deep expertise in at least one biological discipline.
  • Strong ability to interpret scientific experiments, data, and research findings.
  • Strong understanding of experimental design and scientific reasoning.

title: Principal FPGA Design Engineer
description:
About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.


Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit www.sitime.com

Job Summary

We are seeking a seasoned FPGA Architect with a minimum of 10 years of experience to lead the design and development of FPGA-based platforms that support internal testing and validation of our precision, high-performance MEMS timing products. This role is critical to developing robust infrastructure for frequency measurement, low phase noise and low jitter characterization, production, and system-level validation

Responsibilities:

  • Architect and implement scalable FPGA solutions for internal hardware platforms used in MEMS timing product testing
  • Lead cross-functional technical initiatives involving CMOS design, MEMS design, systems and test engineering, validation, and production teams
  • Define and drive system-level requirements, ensuring alignment across hardware, software, and test domains
  • Own the full FPGA lifecycle: architecture, RTL design, simulation, synthesis, timing closure, and bring-up
  • Develop reusable IP blocks and maintain a modular, maintainable FPGA infrastructure
  • Champion design reviews, documentation standards, and continuous improvement practices
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers and influence strategic direction across multiple programs
  • Act as a key technical liaison between engineering, product, and operations teams to ensure seamless integration and execution

Qualifications & Requirements :

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in FPGA architecture and development (Xilinx, Intel/Altera, or similar)
  • Deep expertise in Verilog/VHDL, simulation tools (ModelSim, Vivado, etc.), and scripting (Python, TCL)
  • Proven track record in designing systems with low jitter, low phase noise, and high signal fidelity
  • Strong understanding of timing analysis, clock domain crossing, and high-speed interfaces (PCIe, DDR, SERDES)
  • Experience with lab bring-up, debugging tools (logic analyzers, oscilloscopes), and test automation
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving cross-functional initiatives and delivering complex technical programs
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in MEMS or timing product domains
  • Familiarity with hardware/software co-design and embedded systems
  • Exposure to production test environments and ATE systems
  • Experience presenting technical strategies and outcomes to executive leadership

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.


The annual base salary range for this role is $148,320.00 – $203,940.00. description:
OPERATIONS

Paratransit Van Operator

HARTPlus Career Opportunity

$22.72 per hour per union contract

Monday, November 9, 2026

Up to $32.46 per hour at 61 to 72 months

4305 East 21st Avenue, Tampa, Florida 33605

Position

Union represented with benefits and no CDL required

A Driving Career With Purpose

HART is recruiting safe, dependable and service-minded drivers to provide reliable transportation for people with disabilities who use HARTPlus to reach essential destinations. Experience with Uber or Lyft, passenger transportation, shuttle or van service, delivery, senior transportation, non-emergency medical transportation, or customer service can transfer well to this role. A commercial driver's license is not required; applicants must possess a valid Florida Class E driver's license and meet HART's established driving and employment requirements.

Your Pay Progression

The contractual wage progression for Bus Operators, Paratransit Van Operators and Motormen effective October 1, 2026, is shown below.

Months of service

Hourly rate

0 to 12 months

$22.72

13 to 24 months

$24.02

25 to 36 months

$25.64

37 to 48 months

$27.59

49 to 60 months

$29.86

61 to 72 months

$32.46

Wage progression and other employment conditions are governed by the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

Why Choose HART

Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive employment package that may include:

  • Stable employment with a public transit agency and contractual wage progression.
  • Medical, dental and vision plan options.
  • Participation in the Florida Retirement System and an optional 457(b) plan with a company match of up to 4 percent for ATU employees.
  • Starting annual accrual of 104 vacation hours and 78 sick leave hours, plus up to 12 Board-approved holidays, including two floating holidays.
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $5,250 per year; company-paid life, accidental death and dismemberment, and long-term disability insurance; free HART transportation; uniform allowance; and training and career-growth opportunities.

Eligibility, coverage, accruals and other benefit provisions are governed by the applicable collective bargaining agreement, official plan documents and HART policies.

What You Will Do

  • Transport passengers with disabilities safely, courteously and within the scheduled times shown on the daily manifest.
  • Pick up and drop off customers at designated locations while providing professional and respectful service.
  • Operate HART paratransit vehicles using defensive-driving practices and established safety procedures.
  • Operate wheelchair lifts, ramps and securement systems safely and correctly.
  • Assist customers with boarding and exiting the vehicle in accordance with HART procedures.
  • Accommodate customers traveling with service animals as required by the Americans with Disabilities Act.
  • Answer questions about HARTPlus services, fares and general service information.
  • Collect and account for customer fares.
  • Obtain vehicle assignments, manifests and other required materials from Dispatch.
  • Complete required pre-trip vehicle and equipment inspections before entering service.
  • Inspect assigned vehicles for unreported damage or safety concerns.
  • Communicate customer no-shows, delays, service interruptions and operational concerns to Dispatch.
  • Report mechanical defects, road hazards, equipment malfunctions and other safety or service concerns.
  • Prepare accurate, factual and concise accident and incident reports.
  • Participate in passenger counts, surveys and the distribution of HART information when assigned.
  • Operate HARTFlex service when needed and perform other work-related duties as assigned.

What Success Looks Like

  • Safety first. You place passenger and public safety at the center of every decision.
  • You report to work consistently and on time and follow manifests, procedures and Dispatch instructions.
  • Respectful service. You treat every customer with dignity, patience and professionalism.
  • You remain calm during difficult interactions, traffic delays and unexpected service conditions.
  • Clear communication. You communicate effectively with customers, Dispatch, supervisors and coworkers.
  • You operate accessibility equipment correctly and accurately document fares, inspections, incidents and service concerns.

What You Bring

Required

  • At least 18 years of age.
  • A valid Florida Class E driver's license.
  • Ability to meet HART's established driving-record and insurability requirements.
  • Ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with customers, Dispatch, supervisors and coworkers.
  • Ability to maintain required records, prepare accurate reports and perform basic calculations.
  • Ability to remain courteous and composed while working under pressure or experiencing interruptions.
  • Ability to interact respectfully with people with a wide range of disabilities, backgrounds and communication needs.
  • Ability to meet HART's attendance and punctuality requirements and work as a flexible, dependable team member.

Preferred

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • At least one year of experience operating an eight-passenger van or similar vehicle.
  • Experience in rideshare, paratransit, non-emergency medical transportation, senior transportation, shuttle service, passenger transportation, delivery or customer service.
  • Familiarity with streets, communities and major destinations throughout Hillsborough County and the City of Tampa.
  • Knowledge of defensive-driving practices.

Schedule Expectations

HART provides transportation services throughout the week. Assigned schedules may include early mornings, evenings, weekends and holidays based on operational requirements. Operators must report at their assigned time and remain flexible when service conditions or assignments change. Shift assignments and other working conditions are governed by operational needs and the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

This position requires the ability to:

  • Sit and operate a paratransit vehicle for extended periods.
  • Frequently communicate and listen to customers and Dispatch.
  • Bend, kneel, reach and stretch while inspecting vehicles or operating accessibility equipment.
  • Safely operate wheelchair lifts, ramps and passenger-securement systems.
  • Maintain the visual and hearing ability necessary to operate a passenger vehicle safely.
  • Drive during daylight and nighttime hours.
  • Work in changing weather conditions, including heat, cold and rain.
  • Work around vehicle noise, traffic, exhaust fumes and other conditions associated with passenger-transportation operations.

Reasonable accommodations may be available to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Safety Sensitive Position

This is a safety-sensitive position. Employment is subject to HART's established hiring requirements, which may include verification of qualifications and driver's license, motor-vehicle-record review, background screening, physical-capability or medical evaluation where applicable, pre-employment drug testing, ongoing testing required under applicable Federal Transit Administration and U.S. Department of Transportation regulations, and successful completion of required training and probationary requirements.

All HART employees are responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for customers, coworkers, contractors and visitors. Employees must follow applicable health, safety, security and quality procedures; report accidents and hazardous conditions; and properly use and care for assigned vehicles, equipment and materials.

Apply to Join HART

Every HARTPlus trip provides someone with greater independence and access to the community. If you are a safe, dependable and service-minded driver looking for stability, comprehensive benefits and meaningful work, apply today and prepare to join the November 9, 2026 training class.
