title: Technician 3
description:
About Us

At American Engineering Testing (AET), we believe that people are the heart of innovation. We create an environment that values teamwork, curiosity, and continuous improvement while delivering innovative engineering and consulting solutions. As a 100% employee-owned firm, we deliver comprehensive testing, analysis, and design to reduce uncertainty in construction projects and offer rewarding work, exceptional training, and career development opportunities.


Job Summary

Technician 3 is a senior-level field and lab technician responsible for executing complex construction materials testing, mentoring junior staff, and supporting project management activities. This role demands advanced technical proficiency, leadership in field operations, and a strong commitment to quality assurance and safety. Technician 3s serve as technical leads on-site, ensuring compliance with standards such as ASTM, AASHTO, and ACI, while also contributing to process improvements and client satisfaction.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations or workable solutions may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Advanced Field and Laboratory Testing

  • Perform and oversee testing of soils, concrete, bituminous, and masonry products.
  • Lead execution of field density and Proctor density tests, plastic concrete testing, and bituminous lab analyses.
  • Conduct complex evaluations of excavation sites and correlate findings with geotechnical data.
  • Perform hand auger borings and advanced sampling under minimal supervision.
  • Ensure calibration and maintenance of lab equipment and instruments.

Project Leadership and Oversight

  • Act as lead technician on multi-phase projects, coordinating field teams and schedules.
  • Support project managers in planning, budgeting, and client communications.
  • Review and validate technical reports, ensuring accuracy and clarity.
  • Mentor Technician 1 and 2 staff, providing guidance on testing protocols and safety practices.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Communicate directly with clients, contractors, and suppliers to coordinate testing and resolve issues.
  • Represent the company professionally during site visits, inspections, and client meetings.
  • Provide technical insights and recommendations to clients based on field observations and test results.

Compliance and Safety

  • Ensure all work complies with federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Uphold AET’s QA/QC and Health & Safety policies in all field and lab activities.
  • Maintain documentation for audits, certifications, and regulatory reviews.

Continuous Improvement and Development

  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and contribute to departmental improvements.
  • Participate in technician career framework initiatives and leadership development programs. Career Frameworks: Technicians Job Family Project Launch
  • Stay current with industry standards, certifications, and emerging technologies.

Administrative and Logistical Duties

  • Maintain high chargeable productivity and accurate time tracking.

Supervisory Responsibility

May provide work direction on projects and job sites.


Required Qualifications and Requirements

  • High school diploma required; associate degree or technical certification preferred.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in construction materials testing.
  • Advanced knowledge of ASTM, AASHTO, and ACI standards.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
  • A minimum of 5 years of related engineering technician experience with quality control testing of construction materials.
  • Other state DOT certifications a plus.
  • Capable of the physical labor required including work at hazardous waste sites, with personal protective equipment.


Required Certifications

  • MN DOT Bituminous Certification (Level I or II)
  • MN DOT Grading and Base Certification
  • OSHA 10-Hour Construction Safety and Health
  • Valid Driver’s License with Acceptable Driving Record


Preferred Certifications

  • ACI Concrete Strength Testing Technician
  • Nuclear Gauge Safety and Operation Certification
  • Valid Driver’s License with Acceptable Driving Record


Preferred Skills

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or Geology preferred.
  • Field certifications such as ACI Field Testing Grade I, NICET, OSHA 10-Hour Construction Safety and Health or equivalent.
  • Strong working knowledge of field standards and test methods (ASTM, AASHTO).
  • Experience using project tracking systems such as QEST or Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Excellent communication and team leadership skills, with the ability to train and motivate technicians.
  • Proven ability to manage shifting priorities in a high-volume, fast-paced field environment.


Pay Transparency

Base compensation is expected to be in the range of $27.00 to $32.00 per hour based on skill set and experience. AET offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health benefits, insurance, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), long-term savings, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. The selected candidate must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.


Work Environment

This job operates in both a field and office environment. This position also requires field work in outdoor conditions on construction sites with uneven ground and adverse weather conditions. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and photocopiers.

The employee is required to frequently work outside. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Automation & Integrations
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to take ownership of our email and LinkedIn automation platform and workflow builder. This role combines backend development, frontend engineering, infrastructure, and deep technical ownership of a key product area.

You will work hands‑on on production systems, maintaining and extending our automation platform, supporting integrations, and improving deliverability and reliability. You will also contribute to architectural, security, and infrastructure decisions, and take responsibility for the technical health of this part of the product.

We’re looking for a product‑minded engineer who cares deeply about reliability and user experience. You are a strong problem solver who can operate autonomously and take ownership of your work. You’re comfortable wearing multiple hats — from developer to infrastructure owner to technical support lead — and you communicate clearly while collaborating effectively with engineering, product, and customer success teams.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs using PHP with the Slim Framework. You will implement the core business logic behind automation workflows, data processing, and system orchestration. You will be responsible for maintaining PostgreSQL databases, including per‑customer schemas, migrations, and performance optimization.

On the frontend, you will build and maintain React components for the workflow builder and automation interfaces. You will manage application state and real‑time updates using WebSockets, and work closely with product and UX to improve usability and reliability.

You will also take ownership of infrastructure and operations. This includes configuring and maintaining AWS services such as ECS (Fargate), Elastic Load Balancers, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, and related networking and security services. Monitoring system health, performance, and error handling is a core part of the role.

Beyond the core platform, you will develop and maintain Node.js services used for background jobs and integrations. You will handle third-line technical support escalations together with Customer Success, perform root‑cause analysis, and implement long‑term fixes. You will contribute to security best practices, compliance and data protection requirements, and the technical preparation for CASA certification and similar standards.

Domain-Specific Responsibilities

A significant part of the role focuses on systems related to email and LinkedIn automation. This includes working with email automation using SMTP and IMAP, improving deliverability and sending reputation, maintaining LinkedIn automation and integrations, and building and supporting multi‑step outbound workflows.

You will work with browser automation tools, including existing Puppeteer workflows that are being phased out, and integrations with third‑party automation providers. You will also maintain and extend a Chrome extension written in JavaScript and TypeScript that supports browser-based automation workflows.

Who are you

  • You have a strong experience with: PHP (Slim Framework), Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, AWS production infrastructure

  • A solid understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous systems, and distributed services

  • Experience debugging production systems and handling live incidents

  • Comfortable working across backend, frontend, infrastructure, and support contexts

  • Ability to work independently and take full ownership of a product area

What do we offer?

  • An international team with enthusiastic colleagues.

  • A clear career path with (international) growth opportunities.

  • 26 vacation days plus an extra day off on your birthday.

  • 8% holiday allowance per year.

  • A solid pension plan.

  • A hybrid working model: partly in the office, partly from home.

  • A flexible monthly budget of €50 (for example for sports, hotel stays, meal boxes, and more).

  • The option to work fully remote for 2 weeks per year.

  • Everything you need to perform: tools, training, and support.

  • Daily lunch and snacks.

  • Table football, Xbox, and Mario Kart to relax during the day.

  • Friday afternoon drinks and regular social events and parties.

title: Public Policy Coordinator
description:
The Public Policy Coordinator leads legislative and programmatic advocacy on issues affecting rural and Indigenous communities across Communities Unlimited’s seven-state region, providing analysis, recommendations, and advocacy for legislative and regulatory changes. The role represents Communities Unlimited in national advocacy coalitions, develops policy communications and campaigns in collaboration with the Communications Team, and supports organizational advocacy priorities. Additionally, the position provides policy, partner, and administrative support to the CEO and senior leadership team.

Benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account with annual employer contributions
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Company-paid Short-Term & Long-Term Disability and Basic Life Insurance
  • Employer 401k Match
  • Paid holiday, vacation and sick time.

Requirements

  • Education
    • Option A - Bachelor’s degree in public policy, political science or similar field and 3 years of work experience in government relations, legislative affairs, public policy, advocacy, or similar field.

    • Option B - Master’s degree in public policy, political science, or similar field preferred.

  • Ability to travel 10%-15%, with some travel being in concentrated periods of time.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and geographies, engage policymakers and stakeholders, deliver presentations and public speaking, and communicate effectively with technical and public audiences.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex policy and impact data, develop recommendations, manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently, demonstrate initiative and diplomacy, and provide confidential support to senior leadership.
  • Must maintain a valid driver's license, have reliable transportation, an acceptable driving record, and at least the state minimum personal liability auto insurance coverage.
  • Must be authorized to work in the USA.

Summary of Essential Job Duties

  • Lead Communities Unlimited’s public policy and advocacy strategy by developing the organization’s policy agenda, priorities, workplans, and budgets in collaboration with the CEO and senior leadership.
  • Represent Communities Unlimited with national, state, and federal partners by participating in advocacy coalitions, developing relationships with legislators and government staff across the organization’s seven-state footprint, and advancing organizational policy priorities.
  • Coordinate legislative and advocacy initiatives including Congressional Fly-Ins, legislative committee communications, hearings, agency roundtables, and other external engagements, ensuring effective preparation, follow-up, and action-item tracking.
  • Collaborate across Communities Unlimited to advance policy priorities by leveraging programmatic expertise and impact data and partnering with Communications to develop campaigns, materials, and messaging that elevate the organization’s policy initiatives.
  • Strengthen Communities Unlimited’s external presence and thought leadership by cultivating strategic stakeholder relationships, identifying speaking and engagement opportunities, supporting senior leaders in external affairs, and securing resources to sustain the organization’s policy and advocacy efforts.

title: Graphic Designer (Marketing)
description:
JoVE is the world-leading video platform for scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Harvard, MIT, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company


The Role


JoVE is looking for an experienced Graphic Designer to join our in-house Marketing team. This role is primarily focused on graphic design and marketing collateral production, supporting teams across JoVE with high-quality, brand-consistent digital and print assets.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented designer who can independently interpret marketing briefs, translate business requirements into effective visual solutions, manage multiple projects, and incorporate AI-assisted workflows to improve speed and efficiency while maintaining JoVE's brand standards.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and produce marketing collateral including flyers, brochures, social media graphics and carousels, email banners, presentations, event materials, booth graphics and adaptations, landing page assets, and other campaign deliverables.
  • Adapt approved designs across different formats, platforms, audiences, campaigns, and languages while maintaining visual and brand consistency.
  • Prepare professional print-ready artwork, with a strong understanding of bleed, trim, safe areas, resolution, color modes, and large-format production requirements.
  • Build and update HubSpot landing page sections using Rich Text modules, HTML, and CSS.
  • Use HTML/CSS knowledge to modify layouts, troubleshoot responsive or styling issues, and review, debug, and optimize AI-generated code when required.
  • Use AI-assisted design tools to rapidly prototype first-draft concepts, helping teams establish and approve a visual direction before final production.
  • Prototype landing page sections visually using AI where appropriate, then translate approved concepts into functional HTML/CSS for HubSpot.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate AI into design and production workflows to reduce repetitive work and improve turnaround times without compromising quality or brand consistency.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Studio, Brand, Events, Sales, and other internal teams, incorporating stakeholder feedback accurately and delivering work within agreed timelines.
  • Translate marketing objectives and business terminology into clear design hierarchy, visual communication, and production requirements.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of experience in graphic and marketing design, supported by a portfolio covering digital campaigns, social media, print collateral, presentations, events, and brand-consistent design work.
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, visual hierarchy, composition, and corporate brand systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Canva, which will be the primary tool for day-to-day design production.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, particularly for booth graphics, vector artwork, large-format, and print production.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop for image editing and asset preparation.
  • Practical knowledge of HTML and CSS, with the ability to troubleshoot and modify code rather than relying solely on AI-generated output.
  • Experience with HubSpot landing pages or similar CMS platforms is strongly preferred.
  • Comfortable using generative AI and AI-assisted creative tools for visual exploration, prototyping, coding assistance, and workflow optimization.
  • Able to use AI as a productivity tool while applying independent design judgment, quality control, and brand guidelines to the final output.
  • Excellent attention to detail, communication, organization, and the ability to manage multiple projects with minimal supervision.

Benefits

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • We are fully remote!
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Construction - Billboard Installer
location: Rocky Mount, North Carolina, United States
description:
Would you like to see a different part of your city every day from a bird ’s-eye view? This job is action-packed, and we provide all the training and equipment to start your full-time career. Our Lamar office in Rocky Mount, North Carolina is now hiring a new Operations crew member to help us bring outdoor advertising campaigns to life for brands in Rocky Mount, NC and the surrounding areas.

The purpose of this entry-level, full-time position is to install and maintain billboards, including the installation of advertisements, maintenance of structures, and the construction and upkeep of billboard cosmetics. This position most often works alone and must be able to manage work schedules effectively.

Why Lamar?

Want a career that takes you above the everyday? As part of Lamar’s billboard construction and operations crew, you’ll experience the city from a bird’s-eye view while building and maintaining the structures that keep communities informed. Join a team that values safety, teamwork, and adventure—every single day. See our operations crew in action over on YouTube.
Lamar is a certified Great Place to Work, with 86% of employees in agreement. Lamar Advertising has also been named as a “Best Company to Work For” in U.S. News & World Report’s annual ranking.
  • Learn more about us on our official YouTube channel.
  • Check reviews and company updates on our Glassdoor page
  • Learn more about our Great Place to Work certification.

      What you can expect from us:

      • A Monday-Friday 6a-4:30p work schedule
      • An hourly range of $20 - $21/ hour, dependent on relevant experience and qualifications
      • 120 hours of paid time off (PTO) that increases with tenure
      • 12 paid company holidays, including President's Day and Juneteenth
      • A 6- week comprehensive training program
      • Career advancement opportunities
      • Ongoing professional development and internal leadership programs to maximize your career potential
      • Multiple medical plan options and health savings account
      • Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident coverage
      • Short & long-term disability and paid parental leave
      • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
      • 401k plan with company match
      • Up to $1,200 value in employer-paid HSA contributions and cash rewards for engaging in our wellness program
      • A people-first culture that invests in connection, community involvement, and transparency around employee feedback.

      A Day in the Life:

      As an Installer, you can expect to work alongside the Operations team to install and maintain billboards while prioritizing the safety of yourself and others. Installation most often includes handling a large advertisement printed on vinyl and ensuring it is properly assembled to the billboard structure. The tallest billboard structure in the company is around 200 feet, so comfort with heights is a must.

      Maintenance of our billboards includes construction work such as tightening bolts, painting steel structures, repairing trim and various parts of a billboard sign face and structure, changing light bulbs, and more. As for power/manual tools: you bring the experience, we bring the equipment!

      In this role you'll be expected to:

      • Remove and hang flexes from billboards, remove and hang vinyls, cut and prepare flexes and vinyls for installation, cut, prepare and install copies on Tri-Visions
      • Build and install extensions on billboards, cut brush/weeds, conduct storm damage repairs and minor electrical repairs, and maintain a clean workshop area
      • Use power/manual tools while adhering to safety regulations
      • Attend installer and construction safety meetings as required
      • Maintain operation vehicles; maintain construction tools, equipment, and machinery
      • Take completion photos for proof of performance of installations

      What we're looking for in YOU:

      • Ability to work alone and manage your work schedule effectively
      • Willingness to work at heights up to 100 feet above the ground
      • Strong communication skills. Ability to speak and read English fluently.
      • Willingness to work and get along well with others
      • Basic computer skills, including Internet navigation and Microsoft Word & Excel.
      • Ability to work from ladders and to carry a ladder and/or other tools to the worksite from vehicle.
      • Working knowledge of electrical skills and techniques.
      • Working knowledge of fabrication skills and techniques.
      • Skill in reading technical documents, such as blueprints and diagrams.
      • General knowledge of Lamar, Department of Transportation (DOT), and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) safety regulations
      • Ability to safely use construction equipment
      • Ability to climb heights and work at heights above ground safely
      • Ability to document installations through photographs and written logs
      • Skill in the practical applications of mathematics, in relation to construction and operations tasks
      • Skill in setting priorities that accurately reflect the relative importance of job responsibilities

      Education and Experience Requirements:

      • A high school diploma or equivalent is required
      • A valid driver’s license is required.
      • Ability to complete OSHA 10-hour Construction course required
      • CDL and Non-CDL licenses are a plus, but not required!
      • Previous experience working at heights up to 200 ft. above ground preferred
      • Construction and/or billboard installation experience is a plus, but not required

      Please note: Upon submitting your application, you will be asked to complete an 8-15 minute personality assessment. This assessment compares your professional soft skills to the skills required for success in this role. Please answer honestly; this is not a test! Not completing this assessment could result in disqualification from consideration for this position.

      Candidates with a disability in need of an accommodation to fulfill our application requirements should email recruiting@lamar.com.

      Physical Demands and Work Environment:

      • The primary work environment for this position is outdoors, requiring the ability to work in adverse weather conditions and climb to heights up to 200 ft.
      • The physical demands for this position include heavy lifting (up to 100 pounds), extensive bending, pushing, reaching, seeing (with a focus on reading, color distinction, acuity, depth perception, and peripheral vision), sitting less than 50% of the time, standing, stooping, talking, turning, walking, driving, and climbing.
      • Nights spent away from home traveling are less than 10%.
      • On-call shifts may be required.

      Who we are:

      Founded in 1902, Lamar Advertising Company is one of the largest outdoor advertising companies in the world. With over 360,000 displays across the United States and Canada, Lamar is dedicated to helping both local businesses and national brands reach broad audiences every day.

      We provide ad space through:

      • Billboards
      • Interstate logos
      • Handpainted murals
      • Transportation and airports
      • The largest network of digital billboards in the United States

      We live by the Golden Rule, and we operate with honesty and integrity in every aspect of our business. We are open with our employees, transparent with our customers, and loyal to the communities in which we serve. While Lamar is a large company, each office has its own culture and family atmosphere, making employees feel connected both locally and nationally.

      We are committed to sustainable and environmentally friendly business practices and use a number of innovative strategies to reduce our environmental impact. Please click here to learn more about Lamar's green initiatives.

      Lamar is an EEO/AA employer including Individuals with Disabilities, Protected Veterans, and any other State or Federally protected characteristic.

Message and data rates may apply. You can opt out at any time by emailing recruiting@lamar.com or replying 'STOP' to text messages. Your information will be processed in accordance with our privacy policy.

title: Foreman
description:
SCHEDULE


Schedule: Monday – Friday

Hours: 7 AM – 4:30 PM


Willingness to work weekends, as needed, is required.



JOB SUMMARY


The Foreman serves as the primary liaison between McCrea and the builder, overseeing new construction HVAC crews and subcontractors. This position coordinates daily field activities, schedules, materials, and equipment while ensuring installations are completed according to plans and company standards. The Foreman also works closely with Production to address field issues and coordinate approved changes.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The responsibilities below represent the primary duties of this position and are performed in accordance with company procedures, applicable standards, and job requirements.

  • Supervise and coordinate new construction HVAC crews, sheet metal punch-out employees, and subcontractors.
  • Maintain builder schedules and coordinate daily work assignments, house ordering, and material deliveries.
  • Read and interpret HVAC plans and lay out houses for equipment, ductwork, returns, wall caps, fresh air, and other HVAC components.
  • Verify equipment and materials against work orders and identify missing or undelivered materials.
  • Coordinate rough-in, punch-out, and registers and grilles work and inspect homes throughout the construction process.
  • Communicate with builders, subcontractors, trade partners, Production, and Engineering to address field issues and approved plan changes.
  • Adjust cut sheets and communicate field changes to Production.
  • Track and coordinate the return of eligible leftover materials for credit or restocking.
  • Perform and coordinate assigned service calls, complete service tickets, and escalate issues to the Production Manager as needed.
  • Approve time records and monitor job progress, schedules, materials, equipment, and field issues.

BASIC REQUIREMENTS


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Valid Driver’s License.
  • Ability to safely use basic hand tools and power tools.
  • Ability to read and understand HVAC plans and construction drawings.
  • Ability to effectively lead, direct, and communicate with team members and subcontractors.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize work, manage schedules, and coordinate multiple job sites and subcontractors.
  • Ability to work independently and complete assigned tasks efficiently.
  • Bilingual communication skills are a plus.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS


The physical requirements described below are representative of the physical abilities necessary to perform the essential functions of the position.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, bend, kneel, reach, climb, lift, carry, and use hands to handle tools, materials, and equipment. The position requires working at residential construction sites, including unfinished and newly constructed homes, and may involve working on uneven surfaces, ladders, elevated areas, and in confined or limited-access spaces.


The employee must be able to safely lift and carry materials and equipment weighing up to 80 pounds. The position requires the ability to work in varying hot and cold weather conditions and to safely handle tools, materials, and other objects commonly found on residential construction sites.



WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment described below is representative of the conditions an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of the position.


Work is primarily performed at residential construction sites and newly constructed homes, including unfinished interior spaces, garages, attics, crawl spaces, basements, and mechanical areas. Employees may work in both indoor and outdoor environments and may be exposed to varying temperatures, weather conditions, dust, insulation, construction debris, and other materials commonly found on residential construction sites.


Work may occur around other construction trades, tools, equipment, ladders, electrical systems, HVAC equipment, and building materials, with occasional exposure to elevated noise levels. Employees are expected to follow all applicable safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment.

BENEFITS

Eligible employees may have access to a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance
  • Supplemental Insurance Options
  • Short-Term Disability (STD)
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Training and Professional Development Opportunities


Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on position, employment status, length of service, and applicable company plans.



McCrea Equipment Company, Inc. (MEC) serves as the parent company of the McCrea family of companies, a family-owned organization with roots dating back to 1936. MEC provides corporate and shared services supporting its affiliated companies, which serve customers across new construction, HVAC, mechanical, and building-related industries. Together, the McCrea family of companies is committed to quality, collaboration, and creating opportunities for employees to learn, grow, and build rewarding careers.

title: Oracle Fusion Order Management Analyst
description:
Location, India, Bengaluru


About SiTime


SiTime is the Precision Timing company.


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.


Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.

title: Contracts Specialist
description:
Contracts Specialist

Public Procurement Career Opportunity

Salary

$62,624.34 to $73,448.30 annually

Location

1201 East 7th Avenue, Tampa, Florida 33602

Employment

Full time

Closing date

Until filled

Requisition

26-051

Certification

Professional procurement certification preferred

About the Position

HART is seeking a procurement and contracting professional to manage procurements from planning through solicitation, negotiation, award, administration and closeout. Working independently and with minimal direction, this position develops solicitations and administers contracts of varying complexity in accordance with HART policies and applicable federal, state and local requirements.

You will work with departments throughout HART, lead formal procurement activities, advise internal customers and maintain productive vendor relationships. Your work will help HART obtain the services and supplies needed to operate responsibly, efficiently and in compliance with federal, state and local requirements.

Why Choose HART

Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive employment package that may include:

  • Full responsibility for procurements from initial planning through contract closeout.
  • Experience across procurement planning, competitive solicitations, negotiation, contract administration and closeout.
  • Regular collaboration with HART leaders, technical departments, vendors and evaluation teams.
  • Medical, dental and vision plan options and participation in the Florida Retirement System.
  • Access to a 457(b) deferred compensation plan, paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and employer-paid life, accidental death and dismemberment, and long-term disability insurance.
  • Free HART transportation and opportunities for professional development, industry participation and career growth.

Eligibility, coverage, accruals and other benefit provisions are governed by official plan documents and HART policies.

What You Will Do

  • Plan and administer procurements of varying complexity, working with HART departments and vendors to obtain services and supplies in a timely and cost-effective manner.
  • Work with internal departments to clarify requirements, specifications, schedules, deliverables and procurement strategy.
  • Develop solicitations in accordance with the HART Procurement Manual, sound procurement practices and applicable federal, state and local requirements.
  • Select appropriate contract types and prepare terms and conditions that address the needs and risks of each procurement.
  • Conduct pre-bid and pre-proposal conferences, bid openings and other public procurement meetings.
  • Coordinate evaluations with departmental technical representatives and determine vendor responsiveness and responsibility.
  • Develop pre-negotiation positions, lead negotiations and, when appropriate, chair technical evaluations of proposals and plans. Control discussions with offerors and document all discussions.
  • Perform cost and price analyses and prepare negotiation memoranda and determinations of price reasonableness.
  • Recommend contract awards or no awards, finalize contract documents and coordinate contract execution.
  • Administer contracts from award through closeout, monitor contractor compliance, approve payments and address contract interpretation, disputes, modifications and change orders.
  • Initiate default, termination or additional negotiation procedures when required and maintain effective communication with contractors and HART technical staff.
  • Enter awarded contracts in the contract database, maintain complete files and current contract status, and perform assigned self-audits of contract and solicitation files. Conduct routine contract compliance audits and report findings to the Department Director. Close out contracts by obtaining releases, acceptance certificates and warranties and arranging disposition of retained payments.
  • Serve as backup for purchasing inventory and non-inventory supplies and services, including quotations, pricing, purchase orders and tabulation sheets.
  • Maintain liaison with HART technical departments and industry contacts. Serve as an organizational spokesperson on contract matters and represent HART at tradeshows, conferences and other industry events.
  • Perform other work-related duties as assigned.

What You Bring

Required

An equivalent combination of related education and experience may substitute for the minimum qualifications below, excluding a high school diploma, GED, licenses or certifications.

  • An associate’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Public Administration, Finance, Government Affairs or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Two to three years of progressively responsible experience in contracting procedures, procurement regulations and negotiating techniques.
  • Ability to develop and administer solicitations and contracts while reviewing and applying federal, state and local requirements.
  • Knowledge of public-sector purchasing practices; federal, state and local purchasing and disposal procedures; contract compliance; auditing; and procurement documentation.
  • Ability to perform cost and price analyses, review pricing information and complete calculations accurately.
  • Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, training and presentation skills, and the ability to conduct public meetings and represent HART at industry events.
  • Strong organization, prioritization and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage concurrent assignments, meet deadlines, and set and execute departmental goals and objectives.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, retain important details and remain effective while working under stress or frequent interruption.
  • Successful experience working in an organized workforce environment and bringing work groups together to support productivity and teamwork. Ability to be a flexible, effective team leader and participant, interact positively with internal and external contacts, and manage vendor relationships.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Project, Visio and OneDrive, and the ability to use computers for data entry, word processing, accounting and technical applications such as ERP systems.
  • Knowledge of HART rules, regulations, procedures and functions and standard office practices, procedures and equipment. Ability to concentrate and learn.
  • Ability to meet HART attendance, punctuality, safety and security requirements.

Preferred

  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • CPM, CPPB, CPPO, NIGP-CPP or a similar procurement or contracting professional certification.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment. The position also conducts public procurement meetings and may attend conferences, tradeshows and other industry events. Work requires frequent coordination with internal departments, vendors and contractors, often while managing deadlines and interruptions.

  • Operate standard office equipment and computer systems used for data entry, word processing, accounting, procurement and contract administration.
  • Hear, see, speak and perceive color, depth and texture as required to perform assigned duties.
  • Stand, walk, bend, reach and stoop, and lift objects weighing up to 25 pounds.
  • May encounter potentially intimidating or unreceptive members of the public and may occasionally be exposed to dangerous machinery, extreme weather or extreme noise.

Reasonable accommodations may be available to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Safety and Security Responsibilities

All HART employees are responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for customers, contractors, visitors and coworkers. Employees must follow applicable health, safety, security and quality-management procedures; recognize and report accidents and hazardous conditions; assist with the development of workplace safety procedures for their department; promote those procedures; and properly use and care for assigned equipment and materials.

Apply to Join HART

Join HART’s Procurement and Contracts Administration team and help secure the services and supplies that support transit operations. If your education and experience match the qualifications above, apply for Contracts Specialist requisition 26-051.

Equal Employment Opportunity and Accommodations

HART is committed to equal employment opportunity for all persons, regardless of race, color, creed, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by federal or state law. Reasonable accommodations are available to persons with disabilities during the application and interview process in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act.

title: Senior Software Engineer - UI Software Architecture & Display Systems
description:
At Intuitive Surgical, we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. By combining ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints. As the company’s flagship product, the da Vinci Surgical System advances the frontier of human-machine interaction by fusing computers, robotics and imaging technologies into an immersive teleoperation platform for minimally invasive surgery.

The Interaction Software Engineering team is responsible for implementing the 2D/3D user interfaces and supporting infrastructure for various displays across the da Vinci Surgical System, including an immersive stereoscopic viewer, 2D/3D flat panel displays, and touch panels. The team prides itself in creating quality products that make the customers’ experience of using technically complex surgical devices safe, easy to learn, and confidence inspiring.

The Sr. Software Engineer within this organization works collaboratively across both software and hardware teams to design and develop infrastructure and user-facing features. The successful candidate must excel in a focused, high-energy, small team environment, be able to drive to solutions from high-level requirements, and have a commitment to high product quality. An ideal candidate is an independent and fast-paced developer with excellent hands-on problem-solving skills, and open to incorporating new learnings & ideas in an iterative and collaborative design process.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Work with a cross-functional team in a user-centered design process to arrive at a balanced understanding of unmet user needs and feasibility of technical solutions.
  • Translate high-level requirements into software architecture and algorithm designs.
  • Produce and maintain robust, high-quality software implementations: Design and develop UI software architecture with an emphasis on modularity, reusability, and scalability across multiple products in the da Vinci product line.
  • Lead efforts to refactor existing codebases to improve code reuse, reduce duplication, and enable shared components across product variants: Partition and structure code to support targeted unit test development and automated verification testing, in alignment with product quality and regulatory requirements.
  • Support performance profiling and optimization of the interactive video/display subsystem, spanning rendering, compositing, and video streaming pipelines. Contribute to 2D/3D UI rendering, including display pipeline development for compositing and overlay rendering.
  • Participate in software/hardware failure mode analysis. Identify and implement robust hazard mitigation strategies.

Required Education, Skills & Experience

  • Experience developing and supporting products with interactive UI software, display pipelines, or video/image processing systems
  • Mastery of C/C++ programming
  • Demonstrated experience in all phases of the product development lifecycle including design, implementation, stabilization, verification, and maintenance
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining core software infrastructure with a focus on modularity and reusability
  • Proven ability to write well-structured, testable code, including partitioning software for unit testing and automated verification
  • Experience working in large software codebases

  • Experience with GUI programming in Qt

  • Experience with the Nvidia Jetson platform and Jetpack SDK
  • Experience with real-time 3D graphics rendering in OpenGL using GLSL shaders
  • Experience with GStreamer plugins and pipelines for real-time video streaming

ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfill its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

- Supporting training of OrganOx employees (e.g. Clinical Specialists) and customers on OrganOx approved, as well as IDE and research products and studies

Major Responsibilities

Under direction from the VP, Clinical Affairs and Training, the Clinical Research Enginer will be responsible for:

title: Machine Learning and Geo-analytics (Senior)
description:
Melbourne, Australia

#QuantumSensing

Nomad Atomics is on a mission to make the broad uptake of quantum sensing a reality and simultaneously push the limits of our field beyond what we think is possible. We are building the world’s most advanced fit-for-purpose quantum sensors to allow us to see the world like never before.

Our team is made up of leaders in the quantum sensing field. We believe the time for commercial quantum sensing has come, and we are determined with making it happen.

We are growing here at Nomad Atomics – FAST. We are searching for people who want to finally take the commercial sensing game into the modern era of technology.

Who you are

You are a voracious learner, a problem solver, and a doer. You are fascinated by emerging technologies and excited help build a company with ground-breaking ideas.

You are excited to operate at the forefront of technology development and be the first in the world to demonstrate the true capability of these world leading sensors.

You have an innate attention to detail and enjoy the challenge of modelling real-world systems. If you’re anything like us, you love a challenge and use your skills and creativity to solve anything that comes your way.

Your role

Working hand in hand with the Nomad geophysics team and founders, you’ll help to build Nomad’s geophysical modelling capabilities. This is an exceptionally hands-on role requiring a broad skill set, including software development for field data analysis, forward propagation modelling, noise characterisation and data presentation. You will be deeply embedded in our technology development to demonstrate the real-world possibilities of Nomad’s unique sensors.

The role requires a creative, out-of-the-box thinker, capable of independent work while also engaged with a multidisciplinary team to provide the best outcomes. You will be responsible for end-to-end geophysical modelling development and will be engaged daily in tasks like:

· working with a team of subject matter experts to build forward propagated models of real-world underground systems

· implementing best-practice and novel techniques for potential field inversion

· designing and utilising state-of-the-art algorithms for detection and identification of underground anomalies from potential fields

· analysing and interpreting simulation outputs, including statistical assessments

· helping to develop a new generation of applications for Nomad’s unique sensor technology

· building real-world potential field models to test utility of our unique technology in new applications

· working with technology and deployment experts to develop highly efficient surveying techniques.

Requirements

Your Skills:

It’s not about specifically where you have come from nor what qualifications you have. What truly matters is that you are an impossibly fast learner. People with competitive applications could have skills and experience such as:

· expertise and experience developing, testing and deploying numerical software in Python or other high-level programming languages (required)

· masters or PhD in geophysics, mathematical modelling, or related field

· a strong background in computational methods for data processing and modelling, such as simulation, Monte Carlo simulation, or potential field inversion techniques

· experience working with noisy and complex datasets

· experience in developing, optimising and validating machine learning techniques

· a strong background in statistics and statistical analysis including Bayesian methods

· demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex ideas and problem solve within fast-paced team environments

· a history of thriving in diverse environments that value honesty, open communications, and strong bonds between team members.

If you think you’re right for the role, but don’t have some of these skills, reach out – we’d love to talk anyway.

Benefits

The nuts and bolts:

The role is full-time and based in Melbourne, Australia.

We have the flexibility to work from home from time to time, but the in-person interaction with our tech and geophysical teams will be critical.

We offer a competitive salary, employee share option package and opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

title: Linen Technician
description:
PRIMARY JOB FUNCTION – Linen Technician

The primary purpose of the Linen Distribution Technician position is to ensure daily responsibilities are completed in a safe, timely, and efficient manner.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Take direction from the Linen Distribution Manager (LDM) and complete duties and expectations in a safe, timely, and efficient manner. This can include, but is not limited to:

  • Working the assigned schedule without delay, tardiness, or absenteeism;
  • Completing assigned job duties including delivering of clean linen in a neat and orderly fashion, collection and transportation of soiled linen, accurate recording inventories and quantities of linen, and organizing and cleaning the linen storage areas in accordance with Crown policies and procedures and specific instruction from the LDM;
  • Receiving customer calls for service, recording the nature of the call, and satisfying the requests of the call in a timely and professional manner in accordance with Crown policies and procedures and specific instruction from the LDM;
  • Observe, record, and report to the LDM any instances of linen abuse and poor utilization.
  • Manage linen inventory levels.
  • Inventory exchange carts and build back to prescribed par levels. Transport carts to designated areas in a safe manner.
  • Inventory top-off carts and build back to prescribed par levels.
  • Record data utilizing the appropriate method (i.e. tablets, order sheets)
  • Collect soiled linen and transport to soiled linen storage room.
  • Maintain the linen room in a neat and orderly fashion.

OTHER FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Any other duties as assigned or deemed necessary.
  • Must be willing and able to work with both clean and soiled linen in accordance with Crown policies and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Excellent communication skills
  • Customer-first attitude
  • Comfortable in a team-based environment

INTERPERSONAL SKILLS

  • The incumbent must consistently display a positive company outlook and an energetic style.

DECISION MAKING ACCOUNTABILITY

This position’s decision-making influence includes, but is not limited to:

  • Quantities and schedule of linen to be delivered to the customer.

REQUIRED LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS

Must be able to pass a background check and pre-employment drug screening as well as any vaccine requirements or non-vaccine attestations.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORK ENVIRONMENT

The Linen Distribution Technician position is an active and physically demanding position. The incumbent can expect to:

  • Walk 3-5 miles per day at the healthcare facility;
  • Load/unload linen from transportation devices by reaching, bending, and lifting up to 10 pound individual bundles;
  • Push/pull linen transportation devices, which may include carts that require up to 70 pounds push/pull displaced weight;
  • Encounter, and be expected to safely handle, soiled healthcare textiles;
  • Be able to fulfill the job duties of any other position on their shift in the event of absenteeism by other team members.

  • Fluency with Mixpanel as a downstream consumer of the data you build; exposure to Tableau or Looker

title: Nuclear Medicine Technologist
description:
About the Role:

The Nuclear Medicine Technologist plays a critical role in the healthcare team by performing specialized imaging procedures that utilize radioactive materials to diagnose and treat various medical conditions. The technologist must adhere strictly to radiation safety protocols to protect patients, staff, and themselves from unnecessary exposure. Additionally, the role involves maintaining detailed patient records, calibrating and troubleshooting imaging equipment, and collaborating closely with radiologists and other healthcare professionals to optimize patient care. Ultimately, the Nuclear Medicine Technologist contributes to improved patient outcomes through precise imaging and adherence to best practices in nuclear medicine.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Completion of an accredited Nuclear Medicine Technology program.
  • Certification as a Nuclear Medicine Technologist (CNMT) or equivalent credential.
  • Experience: Demonstrated experience operating nuclear medicine imaging equipment and safely performing standard diagnostic procedures (clinical rotation experience with PET/CT is a plus).
  • Skills: Strong clinical judgment, excellent communication skills, and a compassionate, patient-first mindset.

Responsibilities:

  • Advanced Imaging & Patient Care: Safely prepare and administer radiopharmaceuticals. Expertly operate our brand-new, state-of-the-art Siemens Biograph PET/CT scanner alongside traditional nuclear medicine equipment to capture ultra-precise diagnostic images.
  • Epic and Intellipacs - Experience: Demonstrated experience operating nuclear medicine imaging equipment and safely performing standard diagnostic procedures. Prior experience with Epic and IntelliPACS (or similar PACS systems) is highly preferred.
  • Patient Advocacy: Prepare patients for procedures by explaining the process, addressing anxieties, and carefully monitoring them throughout the scan to ensure safety, comfort, and immediate response to any adverse reactions.
  • Safety & Compliance: Adhere strictly to federal, state, and institutional radiation safety protocols (ALARA principles) to minimize exposure to patients, staff, and yourself. Ensure the proper handling, storage, and disposal of radioactive materials.
  • Quality Control: Maintain, calibrate, and troubleshoot imaging equipment daily to ensure optimal performance, accurate dosing, and full compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Documentation & Collaboration: Accurately document patient history, procedure details, and radiopharmaceutical tracking in Electronic Medical Records (EMR). Partner closely with radiologists and physicians to optimize imaging protocols and assist in the diagnostic process.


Why Raise a Family and Build a Career in Scottsbluff?

  • Nestled in the scenic North Platte River Valley, Scottsbluff offers an unparalleled environment for raising a family. Here, you will find the safety, peace of mind, and close-knit community of a classic Nebraska small town.

title: Real Estate Development Analyst
description:
Summary Duties and Responsibilities:

The Real Estate Development Analyst will provide administrative and project management support to the Real Estate Development team.

Essential Functions and Work Duties:

The following essential functions of this position are performed personally, in cooperation with the supervisor, and/or in coordination with other staff. Additional work functions and duties may be assigned.

  • Perform administrative duties and maintain the administrative infrastructure for the Real Estate Development Department, including managing and organizing department databases, document storage systems, and research databases.

  • Perform market research utilizing readily available on-line tools. Develop research presentations for internal and external uses.

  • Prepare and maintain pipeline and project status reports for use in managing the workflow of the department, and for reporting to the various internal boards and committees using Excel, Word and Smartsheet.

  • Take minutes of meetings and facilitate communication and workflow among the Real Estate Development team, other internal department teams, and external parties, including use of Procore.

  • Maintain information related to other affordable housing developers in Nevada and affordable housing projects.

  • Assist the Real Estate Development team to identity land acquisition opportunities, prepare letters of intent to purchase land, assist with securing appraisals and market studies, and perform due diligence reviews of properties under contract including evaluating title report exceptions and ALTA surveys.

  • Assist the Real Estate Development team in review and research of current affordable housing trends, issues, and financing sources both in Southern Nevada and nationally.

  • Assist with financial feasibility analysis for development projects and update development proforma models as directed.

  • Assist the Real Estate Development team with activities associated with the real estate development process, including the development of funding applications for project equity investments, grants, and loans; responses to requests for proposals; preparation of departmental presentations and meeting agendas; loan closings; and other activities.

  • Assist in preparation of departmental financial projections and reports.

  • Prepare and submit reports to NeighborWorks and other affordable housing organizations and governmental jurisdictions.


Other Functions and Work Duties:

  • Perform tasks which are supportive in nature to the essential functions of the job, but which may be altered or re-designed upon individual circumstances.

  • Perform other duties as from time to time may be determined necessary for the well-being of the total operation.

  • Coordinate specific work tasks with other personnel within the department as well as with other departments in order to ensure the smooth and accurate flow of work and information.

  • Support and assist the Real Estate Development team with general administrative tasks and development processes.

Qualifications and Skills Required:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in business, Urban Planning, Real Estate, or a related field is preferred. In lieu of a degree, college studies or certificates in the same fields are acceptable and/or 3–5-years work experience in related fields such as paralegal, project management or real estate transactions.

title: RFP Print Buying and Pricing Analyst
description:
Taylor Corporation is a dynamic, diversified company with big plans for the future ― and your career. We power our employees’ potential and strive to create opportunity and security for every member of the team. If you’re ready for something bigger ― more challenge, more variety, more pathways for professional growth ― we should talk. We’re passionate about our work, we believe there is always a better way, and we’re looking for people like you.

Ready to reach your potential? It’s time to look at Taylor.

Your Opportunity: Taylor Corporation is seeking an RFP Print Buying and Pricing Analyst to help shape competitive, accurate, and profitable responses for complex customer opportunities. In this highly collaborative role, you will serve as the central point of coordination for print sourcing, vendor quote management, market pricing analysis, and customer-facing pricing support across RFI, RFP, and RFQ opportunities. You will partner with sales, sourcing, category management, finance, operations, and RFP teams to evaluate specifications, identify the right supplier options, assess market competitiveness, and develop clear pricing recommendations that influence business decisions.

Work Authorization: To be considered for the Taylor opportunities, candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Leads print buying and sourcing activities for qualified RFP opportunities, including requesting vendor quotes, comparing suppliers, developing pricing workbooks, and preparing customer-facing pricing recommendations aligned with customer specifications and margin strategy.
  • Interprets print, promotional, label, kitting, distribution, and related production specifications to determine appropriate buying paths, supplier fit and required cost inputs.
  • Analyzes customer requirements, historical pricing, supplier quotes, and available market data to evaluate competitiveness, identify pricing gaps, and recommend adjustments or sourcing alternatives.
  • Works directly with sourcing, sales, category management, finance, operations, distribution, and other subject matter experts to validate assumptions, obtain vendor input, and support data-driven pricing decisions.
  • Participates in RFP kickoff, sourcing, costing, and pricing review meetings; provides print buying guidance, supplier feedback, and market competitiveness insights.
  • Evaluates total landed cost, including print production, materials, freight, warehousing, pick-and-pack, fulfillment, finance charges, and other relevant cost drivers, to identify pricing risks and opportunities.
  • Applies margin guidance to develop accurate, complete costing and pricing workbooks; documents supplier-selection rationale, key assumptions, and pricing risks; and delivers materials to the RFP team within established timelines.
  • Maintains pricing files, vendor quote documentation, sourcing assumptions, and profitability analysis support materials; expedites information to stakeholders as required throughout the RFP process.
  • Supports ISO quality reviews and audits for print RFP processes by maintaining complete, accurate, and traceable sourcing and pricing documentation.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

You Must Have:

  • 5+ years in print buying, print procurement, sourcing, estimating, costing, pricing analysis, or print management services.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, finance, operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Advanced skill using spreadsheets and reporting tools to analyze supplier quotes, historical spend, market benchmarks, pricing scenarios, and profitability.
  • Strong understanding of print, promotional, label, packaging, and related production processes, including materials, equipment capabilities, production rates, and supplier cost drivers.
  • Advanced skills with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook, including the ability to build and maintain detailed pricing workbooks and communicate findings clearly.

We Would Also Prefer:

  • Use of Salesforce reports, dashboards, opportunity data, pricing fields, or related analytics to evaluate RFP trends and market competitiveness.
  • Comparing vendor capabilities, negotiating or challenging supplier pricing, and documenting supplier selection rationale for complex customer opportunities.
  • Communicate complex sourcing and pricing recommendations clearly and professionally to technical and nontechnical stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
  • Manage multiple RFP timelines, vendor inputs, pricing assumptions, and stakeholder requests while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Apply strong critical-thinking, decision-making, and analytical problem-solving skills to identify pricing risks, evaluate alternatives, and recommend a course of action.
  • Work independently, exercise sound judgment, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $70k-$85k. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. The range listed is just one component of Taylor Corporation’s total compensation and benefits package for employees.

About Taylor Corporation

One of the largest print and communications firms in North America, Taylor’s family of companies provides a diverse set of products, services and technologies that address the toughest business challenges. We work diligently each day to create printed and digital marketing communication solutions that help power many of the world’s most recognizable brands.

With more than 50 years of category expertise and 10,000 employees spanning dozens of U.S. states and multiple countries, Taylor serves businesses and distributors both large and small. Our employees enjoy a comprehensive benefit package including a choice of several health plans, dental, vision, wellness programs, life and disability coverage, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off (PTO) and 64 hours of annual holiday pay.

The Employer retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

Taylor Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Taylor Corporation including all partners and affiliates is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

title: Life Sciences Researcher
description:
Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs.

Role Overview

We are looking for experienced Life Sciences researchers and subject-matter experts to create advanced scientific reasoning tasks for an AI evaluation benchmark focused on biology and related disciplines.

This is a non-coding research role. The work centers on designing rigorous, self-contained scientific problems based on realistic experiments, biological data, figures, sequences, structures, literature-style evidence, and research scenarios. The goal is to create tasks that test whether AI systems can genuinely interpret evidence, reason scientifically, and synthesize information, rather than simply recall facts.

Relevant backgrounds include Molecular Biology, Genetics & Genomics, Cell Biology, Biochemistry, Neuroscience, Microbiology, Immunology, Evolutionary Biology, Ecology, Structural Biology, Biophysics, Developmental Biology, Cancer Biology, Pharmacology, and related fields.

CONTRACT: Contractor assignment, 6 weeks

COMMITMENT: Hourly, up to 40h/week

LOCATIONS: Remote - Argentina, Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Nigeria , Ghana, India, Indonesia, Turkey, Vietnam, Kenya, Pakistan, Chile, Peru, Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia, Nepal, Mexico

PROCESS: Application form -> 60 min online test (analyzing biochemical measurements and distinguishing among mechanistic defects in enzyme variants)

Key Responsibilities

  • Design challenging life-sciences reasoning problems for AI evaluation.
  • Create tasks based on realistic experiments, biological datasets, figures, sequences, structures, and scientific evidence.
  • Write questions with clear, objectively defensible answers.
  • Develop rigorous expert reference answers explaining the required scientific reasoning.
  • Ensure tasks test interpretation and synthesis, not simple factual recall.
  • Validate biological claims, calculations, assumptions, and conclusions.
  • Identify ambiguity, alternative valid interpretations, and poorly constrained questions.
  • Build tasks that meaningfully differentiate advanced AI models based on scientific reasoning ability.
  • Incorporate reviewer feedback while maintaining high quality and throughput.
  • Document tasks clearly and reproducibly where applicable.

Requirements

  • PhD, postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced research experience in the Life Sciences.
  • Deep expertise in at least one biological discipline.
  • Strong ability to interpret scientific experiments, data, and research findings.
  • Strong understanding of experimental design and scientific reasoning.

title: Project Manager, Regulatory Affairs / Quality Assurance
description:
Primary Function of Position

The Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance (RAQA) Project Manager serves as a strategic project management partner to Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance leadership, with integrated project management responsibility for regulatory strategy execution and quality-assurance readiness across development programs. The role translates regulatory strategies, health authority requirements, quality-system obligations, and technical decisions into coordinated cross-functional plans from clinical development through marketing application submission, approval, launch readiness, and post-approval lifecycle management.

Reporting to the Program Management & Operations organization, the RAQA Project Manager partners closely with Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC), Clinical Development, Clinical Development & Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Pharmacovigilance, Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal, and external partners. The position places primary emphasis on regulatory planning, submission execution, health authority engagement, regulatory commitments, and inspection and compliance readiness, while integrating associated Quality Assurance activities into unified project plans.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Partner with Regulatory Affairs leadership to translate global and U.S. regulatory strategies into executable plans, including submission pathways, content plans, review timelines, decision points, dependencies, and resource requirements.

• Develop, maintain, and communicate integrated regulatory project plans for assigned programs, covering investigational and marketing applications, amendments, annual reports, meeting requests and briefing packages, responses to health authority information requests, labeling activities, regulatory commitments, and post-approval submissions.

• Drive cross-functional planning and operational execution for New Drug Application (NDA) submissions, including integrated content plans across Modules 1 through 5, document authoring and review workflows, publishing and submission-readiness milestones, critical-path management, and final filing activities.

• Coordinate regulatory deliverables across Regulatory Affairs, CMC, Clinical, Nonclinical, Quality Assurance, Product Launch, and external partners, ensuring owners, due dates, dependencies, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined.

• Plan and facilitate health authority interactions by coordinating meeting strategy, supporting briefing-package development, question-and-answer preparation, rehearsals, meeting logistics, minutes, commitments, and post-meeting action tracking.

• Maintain regulatory RAID and decision logs, submission trackers, correspondence logs, commitment registers, and governance materials; proactively identify risks to submission quality, completeness, timing, approvability, or regulatory compliance and facilitate mitigation plans.

• Coordinate responses to health authority questions and requests for information by establishing response teams, timelines, review and approval pathways, source-document traceability, and readiness checkpoints.

• Support regulatory intelligence and impact assessments by tracking relevant guidance, precedents, policy changes, and agency feedback, and translating potential impacts into program actions, decision requests, and schedule updates.

• Integrate Quality Assurance activities that support regulatory execution, including inspection readiness, audit and inspection commitments, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) tracking, deviation and change-control dependencies, document-control requirements, and Good Practice (GxP) compliance deliverables.

• Partner with Quality Assurance and functional leaders to coordinate inspection-readiness plans, mock inspections, evidence-room and document requests, subject-matter-expert preparation, response tracking, and remediation follow-through.

• Facilitate RAQA governance by preparing decision-focused materials, documenting decisions and actions, monitoring follow-through, and escalating unresolved risks, resource constraints, and cross-functional conflicts through appropriate governance forums.

• Develop dashboards and executive reporting that communicate submission readiness, milestone performance, critical-path status, health authority interactions, regulatory risks, quality-readiness indicators, commitments, and decisions required.

• Support functional budget and resource planning by tracking forecasts, external regulatory support, publishing and submission costs, consultant and vendor activities, purchase orders, invoices, and inputs to the Annual Operations Budget Planning Cycle.

• Coordinate external regulatory consultants, publishing vendors, and other service providers by integrating vendor plans and deliverables, monitoring performance and dependencies, and driving operational follow-up across internal teams.

• Apply standardized project management tools, templates, dashboards, reporting practices, and workflow automation to improve visibility, consistency, traceability, and execution across Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance.

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Chemistry, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. An advanced scientific or regulatory degree is preferred.

• Minimum of 8 years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience, including substantial experience supporting Regulatory Affairs activities and at least 3 years of cross-functional program or project management responsibility.

• Demonstrated experience supporting small-molecule development programs from clinical development through NDA submission, health authority review, approval, and launch readiness.

• Strong working knowledge of U.S. Food and Drug Administration requirements, regulatory submission processes, electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) structure, health authority interactions, labeling, regulatory commitments, and post-approval lifecycle activities.

• Demonstrated ability to develop and manage integrated submission plans, content plans, regulatory timelines, review workflows, dependency maps, RAID logs, decision logs, and executive-readiness reporting.

• Working knowledge of pharmaceutical Quality Assurance and GxP quality systems, including inspection readiness, audits, deviations, CAPA, change control, document control, training compliance, and quality-risk management.

• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, CMC, Clinical, Nonclinical, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Pharmacovigilance, and Commercial functions.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to synthesize complex regulatory issues, clarify decisions, and drive alignment without direct authority.

• Advanced proficiency with Smartsheet and Microsoft Office, including detailed project planning, dashboards, reporting, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience coordinating NDA content and submission activities across eCTD Modules 1 through 5, with particular experience integrating CMC, clinical, and nonclinical content.

• Experience supporting U.S. Food and Drug Administration meetings, information requests, labeling negotiations, inspections, and post-approval commitments.

• Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC), Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or comparable credential.

• Experience with regulatory information management systems, electronic document management systems, submission publishing tools, quality management systems, and validated workflows.

• Familiarity with procurement, contracting, and financial-management systems such as Coupa, Ivalua, SAP, Ariba, or equivalent.
